Integrates PFMS with e-Office, Scheme MIS, IFMS, SNA and treasury systems to ensure accurate data flow and resolve reporting mismatches.
Conducts periodic risk-based PFMS analytics by reviewing exception dashboards, stale advances, negative balances, and prolonged UC pendency to prevent audit objections and financial leakages.
Advises senior leadership and Finance Advisors on expenditure acceleration, compression, reallocation, or surrender strategies based on PFMS-driven utilisation analytics and forecasting insights.
Institutes structured compliance reviews aligned with GFR, Cash Management Guidelines, and audit observations, ensuring corrective actions are tracked and institutionalised.
Introduces automated dashboards and alerts for delayed sanctions, idle balances, fund parking risks, and reporting gaps to enable real-time financial oversight and transparent reporting. Implements fund utilisation performance scorecards across schemes and divisions to institutionalise efficient public financial management and ensure expenditure aligns with approved allocations and policy objectives. I use PFMS data to optimise fund flow and improve forecasting.
I ensure funds are utilised and accounted for as per GFR and MoF guidelines.
I strengthen financial oversight through integrated systems and controls.

theme_description: Understands, identifies, implements, and utilises digital tools for accurate, speedy, and effective delivery for superior visualisation and decision-making at different levels of the organisation. Leverages digital technologies and platforms to collaborate effectively and efficiently with multiple stakeholders.
sub_theme_description: Develops and executes services with a citizen-centric approach, leveraging efficient and effective touchpoints, involving end-users in iterative development, assessment, and utilising digital technologies for periodic enhancements based on feedback and learning. Proactively manages change by mitigating risks associated with digital technology, navigating barriers in digital transformation, and ensuring sustainability within the government

proficiency_levels.label: Understands digital service design concepts and applies approved tools and processes to support service delivery and digital initiatives.
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands the digital landscape, tools and components of digital service design. Uses government-approved digital tools (e.g., dashboards, data analytics software, content management systems) to support service delivery, troubleshoot issues, and enhance efficiency.
Recognises relevant IT processes, applications, basic infrastructure, digital components and tools (such as digital identity, notifications, payments and design systems) that exist in the digital sphere and how they can be upgraded and modified.
Stays informed about emerging digital technologies, design tools, techniques, and current trends (e.g., Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Services, Blockchain) and its influence on the functions of the M/D/O.
Applies digital skills of analytics, project management, and data visualisation, utilising tools like Jira, Confluence, and GitHub to enhance the government's capacity to integrate digital technology and deliver services to citizens effectively.
Invests in building M/D/O digital competence on using collaborative tools like Google Drive and Basecamp to streamline workflows and support digital initiatives.
Actively engage with citizens to gather feedback through surveys, focus groups, and usability testing to understand their needs and pain points to ensure betterment of digital services
Provides regular updates to supervisors and stakeholders on progress, challenges, and opportunities related to digital initiatives.
Reports barriers faced by stakeholders in digital technology implementation to senior management, suggesting practical solutions. I use government-approved digital tools, technologies, and processes to enhance digital service delivery. I actively keep myself updated with the latest innovations to implement more effective and efficient digital solutions.
I support the integration of technology across the bureaucratic functions of my department by leveraging digital skills, to ensure smoother operations and improved service outcomes for citizens.
I regularly report updates on digital initiatives, by gathering feedback from citizens and identifying potential risks, towards proposing practical solutions for seamless implementation of processes.

proficiency_levels.label: Manages digital service implementation by coordinating teams, optimising processes, and using data to improve service outcomes.
proficiency_levels.description:
Recognises the need for digital transformation and processes at the M/D/O and learns to adapt amidst change. Leads digital strategy implementation for the organisation, identifies and manages risks by displaying resilience, and managing ambiguity.
Advances cross-department collaboration across M/D/Os to agree on a common set of digital tools, building blocks, and best practices (such as guiding principles, style guides, reference manuals) for effective public service delivery.
Builds process flows and models to help stakeholders understand the current and future state of the processes at the M/D/O and to reshape any and all government interactions to improve responsiveness to need for digital services by using tools such as Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, etc.
Organises relevant training and skill building opportunities (such as mentoring, communities of practice, show and tell meetings, etc) for the team to build M/D/O capability and to address skill gaps; helping build a sustainable digital transition.
Reviews digital strategy, checks for current gaps and challenges (for e.g., duplications, overlaps, activities that do not contribute to the service delivery process, etc), and sets metrics to track (such as digital take-up, citizen satisfaction, digital service completion rate, etc).
Evaluates goals and progress against set metrics (for e.g., by leveraging technology and softwares such as Trello, Basecamp, Databox, Google Drive, etc). I lead and support the execution of digital service design strategies by identifying risks, organising relevant training, adapting to changes, and ensuring alignment across departments and the M/D/O.
I promote cross-department collaboration on digital tools and best practices while regularly informing stakeholders about the benefits and opportunities to sustain digital transformation.
I continuously review digital processes and strategies to identify gaps, establish performance metrics, and assess progress, ensuring ongoing improvements in digital service delivery.

proficiency_levels.label: Drives organisation-wide digital transformation by setting strategy, building capability, and embedding citizen-centric, inclusive digital services.
proficiency_levels.description:
Lists important components of a digital service design strategy for the M/D/O which include accounting for efficient government operations, flexible and secure infrastructure, ecosystem management, intelligent workflows, a focus on transformation and optimization, defining digital metrics, etc. Creates a clear and coherent digital strategy (which includes using human centred design like AI, cloud, and cyber to transform government operating models) that prioritises a citizen-centric approach and addresses key elements of digital transformation in it (for e.g., culture, leadership, workforce, and procurement).
Establishes a culture of ongoing engagement and responsiveness to citizens' evolving expectations, using their input to guide strategic decisions and future service enhancements.
Builds a high-performing and diverse team (consisting of designers, developers, policy officials, lawyers, etc) to manage digital transformation and its sustainability.
Nurtures a digital culture, establishes new working models for the M/D/O and builds a workforce that aligns to taking risks, practises agility and adapts to change.
Engages in thought leadership in industry forums, conferences, publications, etc to disseminate training, knowledge and insights on accessible design, digital transformation, and leadership. Ensures accessibility and inclusion (such as equitable access with transparency and accessibility) while implementing digital strategies, while considering impact and legal requirements of new technologies. I develop and oversee a comprehensive digital strategy that integrates human-centred design, optimises government operations, and ensures alignment with our organisational goals.
I cultivate a digital-first culture by building a skilled, diverse team and recommending training programs that promote agility, adaptability, risk-taking, and sustainable digital service practices.
I lead consultations with industry experts and drive advocacy efforts to promote inclusive digital practices, ensuring accessibility, transparency, and compliance with legal requirements for new technologies.

theme_description: Collects, compiles, and assesses data, information, and knowledge resources in appropriate formats to enable interpretation and analysis for evidence-based decision-making. Scrutinises data and reports with a keen eye for detail, evaluates their accuracy, relevance, trends, and anomalies, extracts insights, and contextualises and critically analyses key points to develop data-driven strategic proposals and decisions while being mindful of prescribed rules & processes of data-handling within the government.
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates the ability to collect and organize data, ensure data quality through data cleansing, protect data, store it, and transform it into usable and appropriate formats for warehousing, analyzing, and decision-making purposes.

proficiency_levels.label: Collects, validates, organises, and presents data accurately using basic digital tools in line with organisational guidelines
proficiency_levels.description:
Identifies and categorises different types of data (such as numerical, categorical, qualitative, quantitative, etc) relevant to operational processes, such as attendance records, beneficiary details, and service delivery reports. Collects data as per organisational guidelines using digital tools such as Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, mobile applications like the POSHAN Tracker, Management Information Systems (MIS), among others.
Ensures data accuracy and completeness by cross-verifying entries against source documents and applying basic validation and cleansing techniques, such as identifying and correcting errors (spelling mistakes, missing fields, duplicate records) using digital tools.
Stores, retrieves, and updates data securely in both digital and physical formats, ensuring compliance with organisational data backup protocols and security measures.
Understands basic data protection and confidentiality measures such as protocols for restricted access, anonymising sensitive information, and preventing unauthorised sharing, among others, as per organisational guidelines.
Applies basic data analytical skills by sorting, categorising, and summarising data to identify patterns, trends, and deviations. Understands how data visualisation and analytical tools like Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, or Google Data Studio, among others, can be used to present findings in an accessible format by developing performance dashboards, structured reports, and real-time monitoring tools to track progress against key performance indicators. I collect, store and organise data accurately as per organisational guidelines using digital tools to improve accountability.
I validate data by cross-checking entries and removing duplicates to ensure data accuracy.
I infer data patterns and present the key insights through basic charts and reports to support evidence-based decision-making.

proficiency_levels.label: Designs and implements standardised data systems, analyses large datasets using advanced tools, and builds team capacity for insight-driven data use
proficiency_levels.description:
Develops and standardises data management protocols by creating data entry guidelines, defining validation checks, implementing data reporting formats, among others, to ensure data accuracy and compliance across programs and departments. Oversees the implementation of data collection systems by training teams on data collection methodologies such as household surveys, focus group discussions, and real-time mobile data entry using digital tools to enhance efficiency and accuracy in reporting.
Establishes risk assessment frameworks to monitor data quality by identifying inconsistencies through automated validation checks using data validation techniques like conditional formatting, pivot tables, anomaly detection, audits, automated error detection, and cross-verifying entries against field reports using data visualisation and analytical tools, to improve reliability and transparency.
Integrates data protection and security measures by enforcing compliance with organisational policies, ensuring access control through role-based permissions to protect sensitive citizen information.
Analyses large-scale datasets using advanced data analytical tools such as Google Data Studio, Python, R, SPSS, and Stata, among others, for trend analysis, statistical analysis, impact assessment, among others, to support evidence-based decision-making.
Explores and integrates emerging data analysis and visualisation tools to enhance analytical capabilities and efficiency. Manages capacity-building initiatives by conducting workshops, training modules, and mentoring on data handling, visualisation, and security by using digital tools. I design and implement data management protocols and risk assessment frameworks for data collection, validation, and security to ensure data accuracy, security, and compliance using advanced data analytical tools
I analyse and present large-scale datasets using advanced data analytical tools to support evidence-based decision-making.
I train teams to enhance data collection, validation, visualisation and interpretation for better program outcomes

proficiency_levels.label: Institutionalises data governance and advanced analytics to drive data-led policymaking, national priorities, and accountable, future-ready public systems
proficiency_levels.description:
Develops and institutionalises data governance frameworks by setting policies, standards, and protocols for data management, ensuring alignment with national and organisational priorities such as Digital India, Viksith Bharat 2047, among others Aligns data management strategies with government priorities by integrating data-driven decision-making into policy formulation, resource allocation, and long-term planning
Ensures data-driven policymaking by engaging with stakeholders, fostering cross-sector collaborations, and presenting evidence-backed recommendations to shape government initiatives such as Atmanirbhar Bharat’s focus on self-reliant digital ecosystems
Ensures sustainable data infrastructure by leading the adoption of enterprise-level data management systems, cloud-based storage solutions, and automation tools for efficient and secure data handling
Drives evidence-based policymaking by shaping long-term impact assessment strategies, institutionalizing robust evaluation frameworks, and leveraging advanced analytics and visualization tools to generate high-level insights, forecast trends, and inform strategic decision-making at the national and sectoral levels.
Drives innovation in data utilisation by promoting the use of AI, machine learning, and big data analytics to improve forecasting, optimise service delivery, and enhance program efficiency
Ensures data security and compliance by enforcing cybersecurity best practices, implementing data privacy laws, and ensuring adherence to regulatory frameworks such as the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011, Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, among others
Mobilises resources and partnerships for data initiatives by securing funding, collaborating with research institutions, and integrating international best practices to strengthen national data systems such as DigiLocker, Unified District Information System for Education Plus (UDISE+), Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN), among others Strengthens accountability mechanisms by establishing transparent, real-time reporting structures using automated dashboards, open-data platforms, and digital audit trails to ensure program efficiency and improve service delivery I establish data governance policies to align with national priorities such as Digital India, Viksit Bharat 2047, and Atmanirbhar Bharat
I use data insights from national databases and analytics and visualisation tools to guide policy decisions and improve service delivery in key sectors
I ensure compliance with data privacy laws, and enhance accountability through automated dashboards, open-data platforms, digital audit trails, and collaboration with research institutions to integrate international best practices.

theme_description: Collects, compiles, and assesses data, information, and knowledge resources in appropriate formats to enable interpretation and analysis for evidence-based decision-making. Scrutinises data and reports with a keen eye for detail, evaluates their accuracy, relevance, trends, and anomalies, extracts insights, and contextualises and critically analyses key points to develop data-driven strategic proposals and decisions while being mindful of prescribed rules & processes of data-handling within the government.
sub_theme_description: Utilises data analytics to extract insights, present compelling perspectives, and make strategic decisions for the efficient disposal of business, improved citizen experience, and streamlining operations to fulfill the Department's mandate.

proficiency_levels.label: Collects and applies basic data insights to support routine decisions and communicate evidence-based observations within the M/D/O
proficiency_levels.description:
Identifies and gathers relevant data from multiple credible sources to inform daily operational decisions, ensuring alignment with the organisation's goals, minimising the risk of decisions based on incomplete information. Recognises patterns in existing reports or datasets to proactively identify emerging operational issues that require immediate attention, facilitating timely interventions.
Presents factual information derived from data analyses to support requests for resources, process improvements, or operational changes, and reinforces the rationale behind decisions with empirical evidence.
Actively tracks key performance indicators (child immunisation coverage rates, mid-day meal quality compliance data, and subsidy disbursement efficiency rates, etc.,) and adjusts actions accordingly to optimise performance and achieve the objectives of the M/D/O.
Reports inconsistencies in available data that may impact decision-making processes, escalating the need for improved data collection methods.
Utilises basic comparisons and trend analyses from historical data to make informed choices, reducing reliance on intuition and enhancing decision quality at the M/D/O.
Interprets and applies key insights from reports, dashboards, or discussions to immediate work responsibilities, communicating findings to peers and supervisors, while citing data sources for transparency. Understands the value of data as a strategic asset and the importance of data usage to organisation in supporting decision-making and enhanced citizen experience.da I use validated data sources to support decisions, reducing reliance on assumptions.
I detect and respond to problems early by recognising patterns in data.
I improve operational efficiency by making informed choices based on tracked performance metrics.

proficiency_levels.label: Analyses and interprets cross-departmental data to inform team-level decisions and recommend evidence-based improvements
proficiency_levels.description:
Integrates diverse and cross-departmental datasets to uncover patterns, correlations, and systemic gaps, enabling a thorough analysis of public service delivery, enhancing interoperability (e.g., linking health, education, and employment data for targeted policy interventions or using public health data to forecast disease outbreaks in a district) supporting integrated data-driven decision-making. Analyses the quality and reliability of available data before making decisions that could impact personnel, processes, or resource allocation, ensuring adherence to standardised protocols and data governance frameworks.
Anticipates challenges and proposes timely interventions (e.g., targeted community programs, resource redistribution) by analysing historical trends alongside current data, ensuring that decisions are proactive rather than reactive.
Creates compelling narratives using evidence-backed reasoning and data visualisation tools to advocate for policy adjustments, workflow changes, and optimised resource allocation, ensuring transparency and accountability in decision-making.
Mentors teams in the interpretation and utilisation of data for decision-making, embedding data-informed thinking into team workflows through regular performance reviews and outcome assessments. Analyses potential risks and evaluates sectoral benchmarks and comparative data to recommend improvements in operational efficiency, optimise resource allocation, and enhance service delivery I provide data-supported recommendations that improve policies and resource use.
I ensure that decisions are based on accurate data, reducing errors and risks.
I help my team use data effectively, making implementation more transparent and impactful.

proficiency_levels.label: Leads and innovates data-driven strategies to shape policies and drive systemic reforms
proficiency_levels.description:
Leads by example and contributes to the institutionalisation of a data-driven culture within the M/D/O and across the government, ensuring key decisions are grounded in empirical evidence. Critically evaluates large-scale data trends to anticipate future challenges, drive long-term strategic planning, and shape national or sectoral policies by leveraging cross-sectoral data to highlight systemic gaps and opportunities (e.g., Aadhaar-linked DBT Transfers).
Drives organisation-wide AI integration for predictive policy analysis; fosters innovation using AI/ML in governance frameworks and strategic foresight, ensuring responsible AI deployment for public impact, such as using AI-based models for forecasting disaster response or financial fraud detection.
Uses data narratives to effectively advocate for structural and institutional reforms, positioning data as a tool for joint action, shared accountability, and influencing policymakers and stakeholders.
Ensures that data ethics, privacy, and governance considerations are embedded in decision-making processes (e.g., implementing guidelines on responsible AI use in government decision systems, publishing real-time data via public dashboards), reinforcing trust in data-driven governance.
Represents the M/D/O in global or national forums as a thought leader in data-led decision-making to drive sustainable development goals. I influence key policies and reforms by identifying gaps and opportunities through data.
I build trust and collaboration by using data to drive transparency and accountability in the M/D/O.
I ensure that leadership decisions are backed by evidence and have a measurable impact.

theme_description: Collects, compiles, and assesses data, information, and knowledge resources in appropriate formats to enable interpretation and analysis for evidence-based decision-making. Scrutinises data and reports with a keen eye for detail, evaluates their accuracy, relevance, trends, and anomalies, extracts insights, and contextualises and critically analyses key points to develop data-driven strategic proposals and decisions while being mindful of prescribed rules & processes of data-handling within the government.
sub_theme_description: Utilises data based on prescribed rules, processes, and role delegations. Drives implementation of rules, policies, and procedures around data management to ensure its accuracy, consistency, security, and legality through a focus on data protection, data privacy, data quality management, and regulatory compliance.

proficiency_levels.label: Utilises foundational data handling skills to support secure, ethical, and accurate use of data in governance and service delivery
proficiency_levels.description:
Recognises the importance of data governance, clean and validated datasets, and adherence to data protection, privacy, and regulatory standards to support reliable, evidence-based public service delivery. Demonstrates foundational knowledge of data application and governance by identifying key terminologies, components, and standard methods (such as data classification, quality standards, and lifecycle concepts), and coordinates with technical teams to support their implementation.
Understands foundational principles of data security and ethics by recognising common digital threats (such as phishing or data leaks), applying basic organisational protocols (such as encrypted files, password protection, or access controls), complying with core privacy standards (such as consent and data minimisation) and identifying ethical concerns (such as bias, exclusion, or misuse) to support secure, lawful, and citizen-centric use of personal and public data.
Understands how data contributes to policymaking and service delivery by recognising its role in shaping decisions and being aware of associated risks related to digital technologies, social inclusion, and the environment for responsible and informed data use in the Ministry, Department, or Organisation (M/D/O).
Recognises data governance tasks (including the collection, classification, and secure storage of data) by understanding governance policies and handles data with accuracy, consistency, security, following the legal and procedural standards of the M/D/O.
Handles sensitive data responsibly by following ethical practices and legal guidelines (such as data privacy rules, consent practices, and non-disclosure protocols) relevant to the M/D/O, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (2023).
Organises data (such as by time, geography, or population group) to identify basic patterns and interpret routine findings from credible sources to support responsible decision making in the M/D/O.
Summarises key trends using internal and public datasets (such as Census, RBI, NSSO, etc.) and includes basic findings in notes, updates, or team discussions to build evidence that informs or validates data-governed systems or processes within the M/D/O.
Uses data through digital tools (such as spreadsheets for analysis, departmental dashboards for monitoring, or governmental portals like data.gov.in for sourcing datasets) to access, organise, and share information for supporting data-driven governance. Documents data sources and verifies their relevance and completeness before applying them in official communication, to ensure transparency and integrity in data use within the M/D/O. I understand and apply data governance practices to ensure ethical, compliant, and citizen-centric data handling within the M/D/O.
I use basic tools and digital technologies to support administrative functions and contribute to responsible public data use.
I understand and apply rules and procedures to ensure secure, accurate, and compliant data use in the M/D/O.

proficiency_levels.label: Implements data governance policies, standards, and procedures to ensure secure, high-quality, and compliant data management
proficiency_levels.description:
Implements and monitors data governance procedures across the data lifecycle in the M/D/O by applying standard methodologies to ensure quality, compliance, and consistency. Oversees responsibilities of stakeholders within the M/D/O’s data governance framework to ensure coordinated, secure, and accountable data practices, ensuring data quality, integrity, and its ethical use.
Implements regulatory compliance across data handling processes by reviewing workflows, applying legal and ethical standards (such as under the DPDP Act or NDSAP), and facilitating secure data sharing and use within and across teams to promote data use and governance practices in line with M/D/O goals.
Applies ethical practices and data protection protocols to manage sensitive data (such as anonymisation, access control, consent verification) in ways that support data-governed citizen-centric service delivery.
Uses data from multiple internal and public sources (such as MIS reports, Census, NSSO, or datasets from data.gov.in) to inform planning, improve service delivery, and ensure data use is relevant, accurate, secure, and compliant with M/D/O’s goals and procedures.
Validates assumptions and findings by checking data for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and compliance with rules and procedures, and flags any discrepancies or gaps that may affect data management or service delivery in the M/D/O.
Implements data quality checks (such as validation, deduplication, or completeness reviews) to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability of data for informed decision making and compliance with M/D/O rules and policies.
Identifies areas within government programmes or schemes where data use can add value and applies available datasets to solve specific problems or guide M/D/O-level initiatives (such as performance bottlenecks or citizen grievance patterns).
Implements privacy-by-design principles and minimisation approaches to ensure that data is used responsibly, securely, and only to the extent required in M/D/O processes. Evaluates the appropriateness of data use in supporting evidence-based work in the M/D/O by contextualising use-cases, assessing risks, and proposing necessary safeguards in line with M/D/O goals and ethical considerations. I implement data governance policies and monitor compliance across data life cycles, including ethical data sharing, privacy, and protection to ensure responsible and lawful data use within the M/D/O.
I analyse and synthesise data from diverse sources to detect trends, guide service outcome improvements, and support evidence-based decision making.
I identify problems and apply data solutions by leveraging government datasets, ensuring interoperability and alignment with policy goals in the M/D/O.

proficiency_levels.label: Leads strategic data governance by institutionalising ethical data practices and enabling its scalable, responsible use across the M/D/O
proficiency_levels.description:
Oversees implementation of comprehensive data governance strategies in the M/D/O by aligning them with national frameworks (such as NDSAP or the Global Data Access Framework) including elements like defined data types, institutional structures for data stewardship, metadata standards, guiding principles for data sharing, and common standards for interoperability, and integrates these into organisational objectives. Evaluates and strengthens the roles and responsibilities of stakeholders within the data governance framework by ensuring data is utilised following prescribed rules, processes, and delegated authorities to promote ethical, compliant, and transparent data governance practices within the M/D/O.
Leads data compliance reviews, including data audits to assess adherence with established data governance standards, ensuring institutional accountability, regulatory compliance, and effective inter-departmental coordination in all aspects of data governance operations within the M/D/O.
Formulates and enforces ethical and legal standards for handling sensitive data across M/D/O operations by embedding privacy-by-design strategies, balancing public interest and individual rights (such as in algorithmic transparency, consent governance, or data minimisation).
Leverages insights from teams and stakeholders to improve data quality, relevance, and use for strategic decision making within the M/D/O.
Leads the development of data visualisations, dashboards, or digital content that present complex findings clearly to senior officials, and incorporates advanced digital tools to support M/D/O-level governance challenges.
Guides the reuse and standardisation of high-value datasets across M/D/Os by institutionalising open data protocols, such as through IndiaAI Datasets Platform or the India Urban Data Exchange (IUDX), ensuring compliance with open data government principles.
Anchors responsible data management and sharing efforts, including providing public datasets for reuse, avoiding unnecessary recollection, and promoting interoperability and standardisation across the M/D/O.
Anticipates trends, risks, and needs in data use and governance by analysing data practices, using scenario planning, risk assessments, and comparisons with best practices to identify challenges and opportunities, ensuring high data quality and promoting ethical, compliant, and transparent data governance within the M/D/O.
Builds institutional capacity for regular and responsible data use by embedding protocols, review mechanisms, and capacity-building initiatives within M/D/O governance systems (such as awareness sessions on open data principles, dataset digitisation, ethical data use, and interoperability standards).
Formulates regulatory and strategic responses to evolving data challenges by anticipating legal implications, proposing legislative or operational changes, and advising leadership on ethical and effective data use for governance in the M/D/O. I design and institutionalise end-to-end data governance strategies aligned with national frameworks to strengthen accountability, ensure ethical data use, and improve citizen trust across M/D/O systems and services.
I lead team efforts to compare practices and plan for risks, informing strategic decisions on data use and governance to mitigate data-related risks within the M/D/O.
I shape regulatory and open data ecosystems to promote high-value data reuse, transparency, and responsible data management while balancing public good and citizen rights.

theme_description: Demonstrates expertise in managing various processes and procedures related to establishment and human resource management, including manpower planning for efficient and optimal staffing, as well as managing service and personnel matters such as holding DPCs, managing promotions, pay fixation, allowances, transfers, postings, deputations, resignations, retirement, pension papers, employee grievances, reservations for various cadres, grades, and groups of services, and preventing sexual harassment within the Department or Ministry. Recognizes the accountability to provide prompt, accurate, and concise responses to employee queries by referring comprehensively to various FRSR, related rules, acts, policies, executive orders, etc., to satisfy government employees and mitigate factors that could lead to grievances or administrative tribunal cases.
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates excellence in handling establishment matters through understanding extent and applicability of relevant rules, regulations, policies, for various establishment matters like holding DPCs (Departmental Promotion Committee), promotions, pay – fixation, transfer, posting, deputation, resignation, retirement, pension papers, employee grievances etc. to mitigate any potential grievance/complaints rising due to dissatisfaction of employees/staff. Involves setting new benchmarks and incentivizing the exceptional performance of employees. Conducts timely assessment of current and future manpower needs, such as officers, supporting staff, and MTS, in the Ministry/Department. Manages employee grievances, providing prompt, clear, concise, and fact/rule-based responses to minimize administrative tribunal cases.

proficiency_levels.label: Understands and follows prescribed establishment rules and procedures to support routine service, pay, and grievance-related matters accurately
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands the applicability of establishment rules and policies by reviewing and referencing relevant rules, regulations, and office memoranda (e.g., Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 (CCS), Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT) guidelines) to understand the extent and applicability of provisions related to matters such as Departmental Promotion Committees (DPCs), pay fixation, transfers, deputations, resignations, retirement benefits, and employee grievances. Lists and categorises components of establishment-related processes such as seniority maintenance, APAR tracking, service verification, sanction/vacancy status, leave records, and reservation rosters, enabling clear documentation and follow-through by higher-level functionaries.
Collects, verifies, and updates staff data (e.g., joining reports, category-wise appointments, personal particulars) in service registers and reservation rosters by referencing orders, checklists, and DoPT guidelines to maintain accurate employee records and ensure compliance.
Records and updates daily attendance, leave balances either in duty rosters or in platforms such as Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS) by referencing biometric/attendance sheets and leave applications to support payroll processing and HR management.
Receives, logs, and organises incoming establishment-related communications - such as leave applications, pay fixation orders, promotion or transfer requests, joining reports, and pension queries - by following prescribed office procedures to ensure easy retrieval, tracking, and timely processing.
Prepares draft notes, claims, and supporting documents (e.g., processes House Rent Allowance claims, attaches travel tickets for Leave Travel Concession, and checks documents for festival advances) for pay, allowances, and advances by checking eligibility, attaching enclosures, and following checklists, to enable timely and accurate by accounts/finance section.
Compiles seniority lists, Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APARs), and vacancy data to support DPC meetings, and drafts transfer/posting orders by referencing manpower requirements and sanctioned strength to facilitate timely administrative decisions.
Prepares lists of eligible staff for training programs or departmental exams by reviewing service records and applying relevant eligibility criteria to support capacity-building initiatives.
Categorises and logs employee grievances (e.g., pay-related issues, posting dissatisfaction, pension delays), logs them in grievance registers or portals such as CPGRAMS, and prepares summaries or drafts for escalation, ensuring completeness and rule-based referencing for timely redressal. Responds to routine employee queries related to establishment matters by referencing rulebooks, circulars, and FAQs to provide accurate and timely information. I am aware of the relevant rules, regulations, and policies (e.g., CCS Rules, DoPT guidelines) to ensure accuracy, compliance, and proper processing of establishment matters.
I follow standard processes for establishment matters such as pensions, transfers, and promotions to ensure timely and accurate handling of cases.
I categorise, log, and forward establishment-related grievances to the concerned authority to support timely redressal.

proficiency_levels.label: Interprets and applies service rules to independently manage establishment cases, staffing analyses, and grievance redressal with accuracy and compliance.
proficiency_levels.description:
Utilises updated service records and sanctioned strength data to analyse staffing patterns, identify gaps, and support manpower planning by reviewing vacancies, projecting future needs, and informing recruitment or deployment decisions. Processes pay fixation, increment, and pension cases by applying latest government orders and pay matrices (e.g., 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC), DoPT) Office Memorandum, Ministry of Finance (MoF) Office Memorandum and the Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016) to ensure accurate pay, allowances, and retirement benefits.
Drafts and scrutinises establishment proposals and notes for transfers, postings, confirmations, deputations, and probation by referencing service records, tenure, and organisational needs, ensuring all requirements are met and documentation is complete to support smooth HR actions.
Manages employee claims and exit processes by verifying supporting documentation and eligibility, applying relevant rules (such as the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021, and Office Memoranda issued by DoPT and Ministry of Finance) and coordinates with accounts and other sections to ensure their accurate and timely settlements.
Interprets and applies recruitment rules and service regulations by analysing DoPT guidelines, relevant acts (e.g., FRSR, CCS), and matching them with individual profiles or case contexts, to prepare accurate vacancy statements, determine eligibility for promotion, and process establishment matters.
Coordinates DPC processes by compiling APARs, seniority lists, and eligibility data, preparing agendas, and maintaining a calendar for timely action, to facilitate structured and timely promotions.
Prepares and monitors establishment-related budgets by analysing historical expenditure data and projecting future needs to support financial planning for salary and allowances.
Implements and monitors reservation policies in recruitment and promotion by preparing and updating category-wise rosters, applying DoPT orders, and verifying representation to ensure compliance with constitutional mandates.
Manages employee grievances, audit, RTI, and legal cases by referencing rules (e.g., POSH guidelines), preparing detailed replies, compiling case summaries, and coordinating with vigilance, legal, or complaints committees to ensure prompt redressal and minimise escalation to administrative tribunals.
Supports manpower planning and establishment structuring by collecting and analysing staffing data, assessing current and future workload trends, and identifying gaps or duplications to inform recruitment, redeployment, and rationalisation of officers, supporting staff, and MTS. Builds capacity of subordinates and team members by designing and delivering training modules, mentoring teams, conducting reviews, and promoting ethical standards to enhance institutional capability and culture by conducting workshops on pay rules and record-keeping, compliance reviews, etc.. I interpret and apply establishment rules and service regulations to process matters like pay fixation, pension, postings, and promotions, ensuring accurate and timely HR actions.
I support manpower planning by analysing staffing data, workload trends, and sanctioned strength to identify gaps and inform rationalisation decisions.
I manage citizen grievances by preparing rule-based responses, coordinating with relevant sections to ensure timely redressal to minimise escalation to administrative tribunals.

proficiency_levels.label: Leads strategic establishment and HR governance by resolving complex cases, strengthening systems, and institutionalising compliant, transparent, and inclusive practices.
proficiency_levels.description:
Embeds digital platforms like e-Office for file movement, e-HRMS for service records, SPARROW for APARs, Bhavishya for pension processing, and iGOT Karmayogi for training to streamline establishment processes and ensure accuracy, transparency, and timely action in the M/D/O. Streamlines recruitment and promotion processes by mapping procedural workflows (such as DPC scheduling, APAR, and vigilance clearance tracking), introducing digital tools (such as e-Office for real-time file tracking, SPARROW for APAR completion, HRMS for eligibility verification, and CPGRAMS for grievance redressal) and ensuring end-to-end compliance with legal, policy, and documentation standards to uphold transparency and efficiency.
Leads the preparation of high-level responses and inter-departmental coordination by ensuring policy alignment and mediating disputes to support transparency and consensus-building.
Advises staff on policy changes and service rule amendments by analysing legal trends, benchmarking best practices, consulting stakeholders, and drafting policy proposals to align M/D/O processes with evolving needs.
Oversees implementation of reservation and inclusion policies by monitoring category-wise compliance, conducting periodic reviews, coordinating with cadre-controlling authorities, to ensure consistent application across appointments and promotions, and adherence to statutory norms.
Manages grievance redressal mechanisms for establishment and service matters by reviewing grievance patterns, establishing rule-based response protocols, coordinating inter-departmental resolution efforts, and ensuring precedent-informed replies to ensure timely, transparent, and legally sound redressal of employee concerns.
Ensures capacity building and institutional strengthening by analysing individual and organisational capacity building needs in alignment with national training frameworks, designing advanced training programs, and leading compliance reviews to ensure a culture of continuous improvement and ethical excellence across the M/D/O. Drives compliance with establishment related processes by conducting regular audits, identifying systemic gaps, and initiating improvements based on best practices to enhance service delivery and reduce risk. I lead strategic establishment planning, including manpower forecasting, restructuring proposals, and high-level HR decision-making to strengthen institutional capacity.
I resolve complex establishment matters by interpreting rules, court orders, and service conditions.
I drive systemic improvements by streamlining processes, ensuring rule compliance, enabling digital HR systems, and embedding ethical and inclusive practices across the M/D/O.

theme_description: Demonstrates expertise in managing various processes and procedures related to establishment and human resource management, including manpower planning for efficient and optimal staffing, as well as managing service and personnel matters such as holding DPCs, managing promotions, pay fixation, allowances, transfers, postings, deputations, resignations, retirement, pension papers, employee grievances, reservations for various cadres, grades, and groups of services, and preventing sexual harassment within the Department or Ministry. Recognizes the accountability to provide prompt, accurate, and concise responses to employee queries by referring comprehensively to various FRSR, related rules, acts, policies, executive orders, etc., to satisfy government employees and mitigate factors that could lead to grievances or administrative tribunal cases.
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates understanding of the extent and application of Fundamental Rules and Supplementary Rules, including their definitions, relevance, and relation to other rules, guiding principles, general conditions of service, joining procedures, transfers, pay, allowances, delegations, pension, and associated O.M.s.

proficiency_levels.label: Understands foundational knowledge of FRs/SRs to process routine service matters accurately
proficiency_levels.description:
Identifies applicable Fundamental Rules and Supplementary Rules for routine service cases by mapping the issue to the correct rule index (for e.g., FR-22 for pay fixation, FR-26 for increments, FR-53 for suspension, etc )to ensure correct rule application. Reads and interprets basic definitions, scope, and applicability clauses of FRs/SRs (for e.g., applicability under FR-2, scope of FR-22 for pay fixation, eligibility under FR-26 for increments, etc) to determine relevance for individual employee cases, ensuring procedural correctness
Uses standard checklists and office manuals to process joining, pay fixation, leave, and transfer cases in line with notified rules to avoid clerical errors
Refers to current Office Memoranda (O.M.s) and circulars issued by DoPT and the M/D/O to confirm the validity and currency of instructions, ensuring compliance.
Maintains accurate service records and notesheets with rule citations and page references to support auditability and traceability.
Seeks guidance and escalates ambiguities or exceptions to supervisors with documented facts to prevent incorrect decisions.
Applies basic timelines and documentation requirements prescribed under FRs/SRs to ensure the timely disposal of cases. Uses approved HR systems (for e.g., eHRMS/HRMIS modules) for data entry aligned to rules to maintain data integrity. I process routine service matters by correctly applying relevant FRs/SRs with proper documentation.
I refer to current O.M.s and maintain accurate records to ensure compliance and audit readiness.
I escalate unclear cases with facts and rule references to avoid errors.

proficiency_levels.label: Interprets and applies FRs/SRs, resolving cases while guiding teams with reasoned advice
proficiency_levels.description:
Analyses non-routine service matters by synthesising multiple FRs/SRs and related O.M.s (for e.g., combining FR-22 with DoPT pay-fixation O.M.s in promotion with past ad-hoc service, reading FR-26 with leave and suspension provisions to decide increment eligibility, applying FR-53 with disciplinary status and allowance O.M.s in prolonged suspension cases, etc) to arrive at a reasoned interpretation that fits the case context. Drafts speaking orders and notes with clear rule-based reasoning and precedents to support defensible administrative decisions.
Builds institutional interpretative capacity by mentoring officers on rule intent, precedents, and risk-aware application of FRs/SRs.
Verifies pay, allowances, deputation, and pension proposals by cross-checking interlinked rules and delegated powers to ensure financial and legal accuracy.
Monitors updates to FRs/SRs and consolidates changes into internal advisories to keep teams current and compliant.
Coordinates with Finance/Legal sections to reconcile interpretations and mitigate risk in complex cases.
Reviews service records for completeness and correctness before audits or tribunal submissions to ensure readiness.
Uses HR systems (for e.g., eHRMS, payroll modules, Bhavishya, etc) to validate calculations and rule compliance, documenting assumptions and checks.
Applies reservation, seniority, and DPC -related rules consistently to ensure equity and procedural fairness. Analyses recurring grievances linked to rule interpretation (e.g., through CPGRAMS or internal registers) and issues preventive clarifications to teams. I resolve service cases using integrated interpretation of FRs/SRs and O.M.s.
I issue clear, reasoned notes and guide teams to ensure consistent application of rules.
I ensure proposals are audit and tribunal-ready through thorough verification.

proficiency_levels.label: Establishes the M/D/Os position on FRs/SRs and mitigates compliance risk across the M/D/O
proficiency_levels.description:
Interprets complex and ambiguous FRs/SRs issues by evaluating intent, precedents, and cross-rule linkages to provide authoritative advice. Leads the formulation of departmental SOPs, FAQs, and compendiums, translating rules into implementable guidance to standardise practice.
Reviews and vets high-impact cases (for e.g., mass pay revisions, cadre restructurings, pension anomalies, etc) to ensure legality and fiscal prudence.
Engages with DoPT, M/D/Os, and legal authorities to seek clarifications or propose amendments, ensuring alignment with national policy intent.
Anticipates grievance and litigation risks through trend analysis and recommends preventive controls to reduce disputes.
Oversees audits and tribunal responses by ensuring evidence-based submissions with precise rule citations and rationale.
Sponsors capacity building programs on FRs/SRs and mentors officers to build institutional expertise and continuity.
Ensures accessibility, transparency, and timely dissemination of rule updates to stakeholders to enhance trust and compliance Establishes governance for data protection and record management in HR systems to ensure integrity and compliance at scale. I provide M/D/O wide guidance on FRs/SRs and complex service matters.
I standardise rule application through SOPs and preventive controls to reduce grievances and risk.
I lead policy engagement, audits, and capacity building to strengthen institutional compliance.

theme_description: Administration and enforcement of compliance in accordance with the most recent "Central Secretariat Manual of Office Procedures" (CSMOP) to ensure that the Section, Division, or Department operates effectively and efficiently. Understands the issues and analyses precedents, facts, ruling position, etc., and records remarks and proposes actions for enabling the competent authority to review and make decisions for timely disposal. Concisely drafts written correspondence such as O.M., memos, notices, reports, letters, e-mails, etc., to be issued on approval of the competent authority. Articulates all kinds of communications towards administration, policy administration, implementation, advisory, reporting, proposal writing and any other documentation towards handling departmental matters with a focus on good governance.
sub_theme_description: Utilises the digital workplace designed to enable simplified, responsive, effective, and transparent working of all government offices, promotes collaboration, and facilitates effective knowledge sharing in the ecosystem.

proficiency_levels.label: Uses basic e-Office features to perform daily administrative tasks digitally
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands the purpose of e-Office in enabling transparency, increasing accountability, reducing paper, tracking digital communication, and facilitating quick decision making. Demonstrates a basic understanding of e-Office’s digital tools and platforms such as eFile, SPARROW, Knowledge Management System, etc to perform day-to-day activities (for e.g., opening assigned DAK, viewing file movement history, etc) for efficiency and transparency in alignment with the Central Secretariat Manual of Office Procedures (CSMOP) and Digital India goals.
Navigates core modules such as Inbox, Receipts and File View to access files, correspondence, and draft notes for daily tasks such as forwarding dak or viewing previous approvals.
Uploads scanned documents or attachments (for e.g., grievance letters, incoming dak, signed approvals, meeting records, etc) to existing e-files using standard formats such as PDFs and simple naming conventions.
Recognises and follows step-by-step instructions for digital signing, file classification, and reference tagging for procedural accuracy and strengthening institutional memory.
Forwards receipts and files to designated officers based on assigned workflow, typically after inward diarisation or scanning of dak (for e.g., for pension applications or interdepartmental letters).
Utilises basic search functions to retrieve recently handled or directly assigned files, facilitating collaboration by sharing relevant information with supervisors and team members to support timely and informed decision making. Maintains workflow continuity and operational efficiency by reporting technical issues or system errors to supervisors. I understand the core purpose of e‑Office to promote transparency and efficiency, and I use its basic modules to perform daily tasks in line with government protocols and Digital India goals.

I follow standard procedures using approved formats, and seek support from supervisors or colleagues, contributing to a collaborative and compliant digital workflow within my section or department.

proficiency_levels.label: Manages digital file workflows and ensures procedural integrity across the M/D/O by applying e-Office tools effectively
proficiency_levels.description:

Drafts notes, letters, or memos directly in e-Office, embedding attachments such as previous orders, meeting records, or reference documents, and circulates these for approval using digital workflows.
Applies digital signature certificates (DSC) for self or supervisors to secure documents before dispatch, including sanction orders, RTI replies, or policy communication.
Uses advanced features such as linking related files, attaching reference documents, and performing targeted searches using metadata or subject lines for better decision-making.
Reviews and performs quality checks on e-files prepared by juniors, ensuring correct formats, proper labelling (e.g., Dak ID, subject line, date), and alignment with section/department practices.
Monitors pendency and progress of files using status views and takes follow-up actions such as sending e-Reminders, marking urgency, or following up on pending cases (for e.g., delays in RTI response, recruitment approvals, or finance clearances), ensuring accountability at every level.
Guides reportees or peers on standard practices such as receipt diarisation, attaching documents properly, or using correct formats and templates, fostering collaboration.
Documents FAQs for recurring queries (e.g., DSC activation steps, dealing with signature mismatches, use of TOC, etc), contributing to team-level readiness and internal knowledge management and continuity.
Flags recurring operational issues (e.g., system lags, signature errors, missing file links) and suggests minor workarounds or submits support requests to technical teams. Coordinates tactical digitisation efforts within the section by ensuring current files are created digitally and by tracking progress on physical file migration. I execute complex digital tasks while guiding peers in the correct use of workflows, proactively tracking pendency to reduce delays and improve service delivery.
I support digital governance and transparency by monitoring file pendency, tracking decision timelines using file histories, and flagging delays to ensure my section stays aligned with service delivery timelines and accountability frameworks.
I contribute to knowledge sharing by mentoring colleagues on best practices and ensuring consistent application of the e‑Office Manual across my team’s work.

proficiency_levels.label: Leads system level digital workflow improvements and institutionalises e-Office best practices across teams
proficiency_levels.description:

Supports peer learning or structured training and capacity building sessions on advanced e‑Office functionalities like managing inter-instance file transfers, tagging and linking correspondence to parent files, managing receipts from external platforms like CPGRAMS or eSamikSha, etc.

Ensures compliance with larger digital governance mandates such as the Digital India Mission, RTI transparency, e‑Governance guidelines, record retention schedules, or Sevottam delivery standards, by embedding traceability and timestamped documentation in digital workflows for scheme approvals, financial sanctions, policy drafts, or citizen services.
Collaborates with NIC, DG Systems, or internal IT units by providing field-level feedback on functionality gaps or user issues to inform, enhance, and pilot feature upgrades (such as automated mail acknowledgements for dak receipts, SMS alerts for file escalation or movement, feedback loops to improve e‑Office accessibility, etc) to strengthen the effectiveness, responsiveness, and scalability of e‑Office implementation across M/D/Os. Aligns e‑Office implementation with broader administrative reforms, such as transitioning grievance systems from paper to fully digital mode, integrating CPGRAMS or GSTN dashboards with e‑Office tracking, etc. I lead efforts to institutionalise digital workflows, reducing duplication, and strengthening institutional memory.

I enable organisational learning by building searchable digital repositories, curating past precedents, and conducting training sessions - ensuring knowledge is captured, reused, and shared across teams for long-term administrative continuity.

Recognises statutory and security requirements and escalates classified dak to supervisors without breach of protocol. I follow the defined procedures of file/dak management to maintain organised and complete records.

I handle files and dak responsibly, safeguarding confidentiality and preventing delays in processing.

proficiency_levels.description:

Uses eOffice or equivalent digital tools to monitor pendency, prioritise urgent dak, and track file progress in real time.

proficiency_levels.description:

Implements quality control mechanisms (for e.g., Section Officer-led file inspections, reconciliation of dak and file movement registers with e-Office logs, age-wise pendency reviews, RTI and parliamentary record verification, etc) to periodically review the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of records across teams.

Leverages digital tools, analytics, and dashboards (for e.g., e-Dak and e-File tracking, age-wise and officer-wise pendency reports, digital audit trails, etc) for real-time monitoring, traceability, and audit preparedness.

Champions adherence to statutory, institutional, and security guidelines by embedding best practices through staff training, supervision, and periodic audits. Ensures that file and dak management systems directly enable faster approvals, informed decision-making, transparency, and citizen-centric service delivery. I design effective file and correspondence management systems by integrating digital monitoring to ensure audit readiness.
I implement quality control and compliance mechanisms to maintain accuracy, traceability, and accountability across the file lifecycle.
I mentor staff and embed best practices that enhance transparency, efficiency, and institutional memory.

Cross-verifies departmental records and draft responses against official parliamentary proceedings, resolving inconsistencies before submission, to minimise factual errors, prevent procedural objections, and safeguard the Department from reputational risk.
