proficiency_levels.label: Processes routine telephone, car, residence, and personal staff cases accurately and flags exceptions for audit
proficiency_levels.description:
Identifies applicable rules, Office Memorandums (OMs), and delegation of powers governing miscellaneous matters such as telephone, car, residence, and personal staff matters, and maintains an updated reference folder on e-Office. Describes standard work plans and approval hierarchies for each service area before processing cases.
Processes telephone provisioning and reimbursement using the prescribed DoE package, verifying bills against ceilings and approved plans, while logging approvals and exceptions, to ensure compliant payments.
Maintains staff car duty slip register and movement log (for e.g., date, purpose, route, kilometres, fuel, etc) with daily countersigned sheets and uploads weekly scans to e‑Office to deter misuse.
Raises vehicle hiring requests through GeM with the correct category/specs and period, attaching comparable offers or rate contracts to evidence value for money.
Initiates residence allotment, retention, and cancellation proposals via eSampada/e‑Awas forms with eligibility checks and license fee calculations, and files communications to keep records complete.
Processes PFMS payments by verifying invoice, sanction order, and delivery certificate details to ensure timely vendor payments.
Prepares personal staff appointment file noting with prescribed checks (for e.g., bio‑data, vigilance/character verification, tenure, CCS(Conduct) applicability, etc), and routes to the competent authority to ensure lawful onboarding. Creates a monthly exception list (for e.g., over‑ceiling phone bills, duty slip anomalies, unauthorised occupation flags, etc) for monitoring and audits. I process routine phone, car, residence, and personal staff cases correctly and accurately.
I ensure bills, licences, and contracts match entitlements and are paid through PFMS on time.
I flag exceptions early with evidence so supervisors can act timely.

proficiency_levels.label: Analyses usage and compliance trends, and optimises resources to improve service quality and cost control
proficiency_levels.description:
Conducts monthly admin reviews using dashboards (for e.g., checking telephone spend vs ceilings, staff car utilisation %, residence allotment/retention status, open vacancies in personal staff, etc) and issues minutes with actions to drive closure. Conducts sample audits on areas such as telephone reimbursements, duty slip accuracy, and residence retention, recording non‑conformities and verifying CAPA closure to improve compliance.
Optimises staff car deployment using utilisation analysis (for e.g., checking idle hours, pooling opportunities, route rationalisation, etc) and updates the duty roster, documenting savings against baselines to reduce operating costs.
Manages vehicle hiring via GeM with SLAs (for e.g., vehicle age, uptime, replacement turnaround time, driver verification, etc); to monitor vendor performance and trigger penalties as per contract, to maintain service levels.
Coordinates residence cases with Directorate of Estates (for e.g., change of accommodation, special categories, cancellation/eviction triggers, etc); ensuring licence fee recovery and timely vacation notices, to minimise revenue loss.
Onboards and relieves personal staff as per DoPT instructions (for e.g., entitlement, tenure, co‑terminus clauses, etc), ensuring background checks and CCS (Conduct) acknowledgement before issue of ID/e‑mail to manage risk. Publishes bilingual FAQs and guides for sections (for e.g., how to claim telephone bills, how to request staff car, how to apply on eSampada, etc), revising it based on user feedback to make processes user- friendly. I conduct evidence based reviews and audits to reduce costs and improve compliance.
I coordinate amongst vendors, estates, and staff processes to ensure timely service delivery.
I streamline workflows using analytics, templates, and user friendly guides to improve turnaround for end users.

proficiency_levels.label: Leads policy, digital controls, and compliance systems to deliver transparent and reliable administrative services
proficiency_levels.description:
Issues an annual Admin Services Plan with targets (for e.g., targets on spend ceilings, utilisation benchmarks, processing SLAs, etc) for telephone, staff car, residence, and personal staff, and reviews them quarterly to align resources to needs.
Establishes SOPs and digital controls (for e.g., mandatory templates, entitlement validations, exception flags, etc) in e‑Office/PMIS , highlighting deviations and enforcing management responses, to institutionalise compliance.
Establishes SLA-based vehicle hiring contracts on GeM with defined penalties to ensure quality and value.
Establishes M/D/O-wide data handling standards for phone bills, staff records, and residence files, and institutionalises privacy governance to protect personal information of officials.
Integrates real-time eSampada data into departmental housing controls and ensures PPE Act –aligned enforcement frameworks to prevent unauthorised occupation.
Standardises personal staff entitlements and onboarding across the department per the latest DoPT OMs to ensure rule -based practice.
Embeds GFR-aligned financial controls across sanction, procurement, and payment processes to strengthen financial propriety. Mentors section leads/teams by running communities of practice and refresher clinics, and measures capacity building via audit scores and SLA adherence, to sustain performance. I set M/D/O wide policies and digital controls that ensure transparent, compliant, and audit-ready administrative services.
I integrate platforms and rule-based frameworks to strengthen governance and prevent misuse.
I build organisational capability by mentoring and institutionalising standards that sustain high performance.

theme_description: Demonstrates the ability to handle various administrative processes and procedures relating to Allowances & Reimbursement, Leave and Travel related matters. miscellaneous matters (Car, Residence, Personal Staff etc.), Official Language duty and ensures implementation across the Department / Ministry.
sub_theme_description: Carries out all official communication within central and state government offices in accordance with the Official Languages Act, 1963, in Hindi. Promotes the usage of the Official Language in the day-to-day work in the Ministry, Department or Organization.

proficiency_levels.label: Implements routine bilingual communications and basic compliance with the Official Languages Act, 1963
proficiency_levels.description:
Demonstrates foundational awareness of the Official Languages Act, 1963 and Official Languages Rules, 1976 (for e.g., including Region A/B/C classifications, Rules 5–8 on language of correspondence, etc) and identifies the office’s region accordingly. Prepares a simple one-page language-use map for inward/outward communications based on Rules 5–8 and circulates it within the section to guide correct language choice.
Issues Section 3(3) category documents using approved bilingual templates and verifies that both versions meet OL requirements.
Drafts routine letters, forms, and notes in bilingual format, using Unicode Hindi and verifies correct rendering in e-Office, email, PDF, etc, to preserve readability.
Uses CSTT /Department of Official Language glossaries to apply standardised terminology in Hindi drafts.
Routes translation requests to the Hindi Section/empanelled translators with a clear purpose, target audience, and due date to obtain timely and fit-for-purpose translations.
Ensures bilingual visibility items (for e.g., nameplates, seals, signboards, website headers, etc) follow prescribed order and size, to ensure visible compliance.
Compiles Quarterly Progress Report (QPR) inputs (for e.g., Hindi noting/drafting percentage, 3(3) compliance, region-wise correspondence, etc) from section records to support accurate OLPRMS submission. Prepares bilingual public-facing items such as RTI acknowledgements, CPGRAMS responses, notices, and forms following GIGW compliant formats. I issue bilingual documents correctly by category and region, and I keep an auditable 3(3) register.
I use Unicode Hindi with approved terminology ensuring drafts are displayed correctly and read consistently.
I provide timely QPR data and run simple activities that increase everyday Hindi usage.

proficiency_levels.label: Plans and monitors official language implementation to improve Hindi usage and ensure compliance
proficiency_levels.description:
Convenes OLIC meetings with an agenda on QPR trends, 3(3) compliance, and region-wise correspondence and records minutes within timelines.
Conducts monthly sample audits of Section 3(3) documents and outward correspondence, issuing non-compliance notices using standard templates to drive compliance.
Generates MIS dashboards from e-Office (for e.g., Hindi noting percentage, bilingual outward percentage, 3(3) coverage, etc) and reviews trends with unit heads to understand areas of focus improvement.
Nominates officials to the Hindi Teaching Scheme (for e.g., typing, stenography, noting, drafting, etc) to build internal capacity where gaps exist.
Establishes translation workflows with style guides, glossaries, and peer review for critical documents to ensure consistency and reduce rework.
Reviews bilingual quality of website pages, forms, IVR/SMS templates, and brochures for GIGW compliance before release to ensure inclusive access.
Aligns procurement templates (e.g., NIT, bid, contract) with 3(3) requirements and verifies sample deliverables during pre-award checks to extend compliance to vendors.
Conducts root-cause analysis of recurring OL non-compliance and recommends corrective actions to the unit.
Plans, budgets, and administers contracts for translation, signage, training, and supporting technologies to institutionalise the use of the Official Language in official work, ensuring quality, compliance, and timeliness under the Official Languages Act, 1963.
Represents the office in TOLIC /Regional OLIC meetings, shares unit best practices, and adopts relevant directives, to harmonise implementation across organisations. Coordinates with State Rajbhasha departments on inter-government communications to ensure alignment with official language requirements. I run the OLIC cadence, publish usage dashboards, and close 3(3) non‑compliances within set timelines.
I coordinate training, translation, and bilingual updates across files, websites, and procurement.
I submit complete QPRs through OLPRMS and align our practice with TOLIC guidance.

proficiency_levels.label: Sets direction, institutionalises compliance, and scales bilingual practices across the organisation
proficiency_levels.description:
Issues an annual Official Language Implementation Plan aligned to the DOL Annual Programme with wing-wise targets and reviews quarterly, to set direction and track outcomes.
Conducts internal inspections ahead of DOL inspections using a standard checklist (for e.g., registers, signage, training, dashboards, etc) to ensure readiness and continuous improvement.
Integrates Online Controls into e‑Office/PMIS (for e.g., mandatory bilingual templates, validation prompts, metadata for 3(3)), etc) to automate compliance.
Extends bilingual practice to citizen‑facing channels (for e.g., service portals, call centre scripts, notifications, etc) with user testing in Hindi and English to improve service experience.
Tracks regional reorganisation notifications and updated region-wise applicability of official language implementation rules to ensure compliance.
Publishes an annual bilingual compliance statement with metrics, audits, awards/recognitions, and improvement plans to build transparency and trust.
Nominates eligible units for Rajbhasha awards and mentors official language implementation leads to reinforce good practices and execution quality. Runs communities of practice to share solutions and lessons across units, tracking adoption of proven practices to enable scale and consistency. I set direction and accountability for official language implementation through clear plans, targets, and regular reviews.
I institutionalise compliance by embedding controls into systems and daily processes.
I scale good practices by strengthening capability, recognising performance, and improving bilingual service delivery.

theme_description: Understands, identifies, implements, and utilises digital tools for accurate, speedy, and effective delivery for superior visualisation and decision-making at different levels of the organisation. Leverages digital technologies and platforms to collaborate effectively and efficiently with multiple stakeholders.
sub_theme: Digital Tools (MS office, Excel, PPT) & Platforms
sub_theme_description: Utilises digital tools, systems, platforms, Microsoft Office, and software for promoting e-Governance both inter- and intra-departmentally within the Ministry's ecosystem. Demonstrates vigilance in safeguarding data and sensitive information from potential risks and unauthorised access, including inspection, modification, recording, disruption, or destruction by internal or external individuals/agencies.

proficiency_levels.label: Engages with digital tools and follows standard protocols to complete tasks efficiently, maintain records, and support digital operations
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands the digital landscape, including digital tools, systems, platforms, and components of data safety and security (such as data privacy, confidentiality, backups, encryption, etc).
Demonstrates usage of government-approved digital tools (e.g., dashboards, data analytics software, content management systems) to support service delivery, troubleshoot issues, and enhance efficiency.
Incorporates digital tools, systems, and platforms (such as Microsoft Office, Powerpoint, Excel, Artificial Intelligence tools, Zoom, Google Sheets, etc) to assist the government in implementing bureaucratic functions.
Uses basic search filtering tools such as keywords, date of publication, language, type, etc to mark and tag information for easy record maintenance and retrieval.
Demonstrates use of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) in an ethical and responsible manner to generate answers and solutions.
Manages and stores information, data and digital content for easy retrieval (for e.g., by using cloud storage, shared drives, etc).
Identifies main risks and threats in the digital environment (for e.g., cyber attacks, data leaks, compliance risks, etc), and adopts basic protection measures (for e.g., antivirus, malware detectors, phishing detection, etc). Aware of security measures and protocols implemented in the M/D/O and complies with it. I demonstrate effective usage of digital tools and platforms (such as Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, Excel, Zoom, etc.) to enhance service delivery, troubleshoot issues, and ensure efficient record maintenance and retrieval.
I understand key security and data risks in the digital landscape and implement basic data safety measures.
I comprehend that digital tools and technology need to be incorporated in a responsible and ethical manner.

proficiency_levels.label: Drives digital enablement within the M/D/O by aligning tools, processes, and policies to advance e-Governance, collaboration, and data security
proficiency_levels.description:
Evaluates goals and progress against set metrics (for e.g., by leveraging digital tools and platforms such as ClickUp, Trello, Basecamp, Databox, Google Drive, etc).
Recognises the need for digital transformation and processes at the M/D/O through integration of advanced tools and platforms, and learns to adapt amidst change for improved e-Governance.
Advances inter and intra department collaboration across M/D/Os to agree on a common set of digital tools, building blocks, and best practices (such as core project management softwares, cloud solutions, data sharing norms, etc).
Creates a digital strategy, checks for current gaps and challenges (e.g., data governance practices, development of AI policies, personnel capacity to implement the digital initiative, etc), and proposes standards, policies, and capacity building efforts accordingly.
Develops a strategy for organising, updating, and storing resources, facilitating management and retrieval of records, files, and data.
Establishes a data security policy for the M/D/O to safeguard data, records, and confidential information from potential risks and unauthorised access.
Develops implementation guides and model use cases for the ethical and safe use of technology, showcasing the translation of principles into practice to harness opportunities. I evaluate existing digital tools and processes, identify gaps, and propose strategies for improving the Ministry/Department/Organisation wide e-Governance.
I facilitate interdepartmental and intradepartmental collaboration to align on common tools and best practices for efficient and secure operations.
I establish robust data security policies and create guidelines for the ethical and responsible use of technology.

proficiency_levels.label: Leads digital transformation by setting direction, shaping policy, and building capacity to adopt emerging digital tools and technologies
proficiency_levels.description:
Recommends the concept of open government (transparency, participation, collaboration and open data) to promote inter and intra-departmental e-Governance and further national digital transformation efforts.
Reviews digital strategy created (which includes using human centred design like AI, cloud, and cyber to transform government operating models) aimed at improving public service delivery, and addresses key elements of digital transformation in it (for e.g., culture, leadership, workforce, and procurement).
Oversees the creation of legislative frameworks that protect data privacy and security, while anticipating legal implications of emerging technologies.
Proposes human resource capacity assessment for competency gaps identification in the face of AI and digital transformation.
Builds a high-performing and diverse team (consisting of designers, developers, policy officials, lawyers, etc) to manage digital transformation and change.
Contributes to multi-stakeholder dialogue on the use of AI, to outline challenges as well as opportunities of integrating AI at work.
Ensures accessibility and inclusion (such as equitable access with transparency and accessibility) while implementing digital strategies and considering the impact and legal requirements of new digital tools and platforms.
Leads digital strategy implementation for the organisation, identifies and manages risks by displaying resilience, practising agility, and managing ambiguity. I promote open government principles and champion accessibility to support digital governance and national transformation efforts.
I lead digital strategy development and create legal frameworks for data privacy and emerging technologies.
I contribute to thought leadership on the ethical use, challenges, and opportunities of integrating technology at work.

theme_description: Demonstrates the capacity to detect gaps and improvement needs in existing policies in order to translate policy concepts into policy formulation for addressing existing and emerging needs of the citizens. Conducts thorough study and analysis of best practices at State, National, or Global levels, takes advantage of modern innovation and the most recent advancements in the social, economic, technological, and legal spheres while creating & implementing policies. Focuses on monitoring the application of policy and evaluating its impact and efficacy using a variety of instruments for responsible, open, and sustainable governance.
sub_theme: Research and Need Analysis - Policy Architecture
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates the ability to undertake primary and secondary research on a variety of aspects. Analyses and assesses a range of data points and reports produced by or obtained from a spectrum of sources (including but not limited to the subject of complaints, proposals by stakeholders, a range of appropriate indices, reports by governmental/non-governmental agencies, and gaps indicated in the course of interpretation and/or implementation).

proficiency_levels.label: Collects and organises data from approved sources and applies basic analytical techniques to identify preliminary patterns aligned with research objectives
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands research objectives and identifies appropriate search terminology to guide information gathering.
Identifies and accesses relevant information sources and databases, such as the National Informatics Centre (NIC), NITI Aayog reports, RBI databases, RTI Online, MOSPI (Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation) databases, and Economic Survey reports, while performing systematic data collection using prescribed digital tools such as SPSS, Microsoft Power BI and SQL databases to support specific research purposes.
Highlights key information and sources that align with defined research objectives.
Maintains accurate records of data sources and collection methodologies.
Organises complex information into meaningful categories for analysis.
Applies basic analytical techniques, such as trend analysis, descriptive statistics, data visualisation, correlation analysis, and frequency distribution, to identify preliminary patterns in data. I perform systematic data collection using prescribed digital tools and databases.
I maintain accurate records of data sources and collection methodologies.
I apply basic analytical techniques to identify preliminary patterns in data.

proficiency_levels.label: Selects appropriate research methods, synthesises evidence, and evaluates findings to identify policy gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities
proficiency_levels.description:
Identifies and implements appropriate research methods, such as household surveys, case studies, literature reviews (e.g., Economic Survey reports, PRS Legislative Research), and impact assessments (e.g., social audit of government schemes), along with analytical approaches like regression analysis, SWOT analysis, sentiment analysis based on specific objectives. Creates preliminary hypotheses and research questions aligned with M/D/O objectives.
Synthesises information from multiple sources to identify relationships and patterns.
Analyses insights, best practices, and recommendations from government bodies (e.g., NITI Aayog, RBI, SEBI), international agencies (e.g., UNDP, World Bank, OECD), and think tanks (e.g., CPR, ORF, Brookings India) to benchmark policies and ensure alignment with global standards.
Implements quality control mechanisms for research processes while developing and maintaining research documentation standards by conducting data validation checks and ensuring adherence to standardised formats.
Assesses research findings to detect inefficiencies, unaddressed policy areas, or implementation challenges in government initiatives. Recommends corrective measures to enhance effectiveness and responsiveness.
Monitors economic indicators, demographic trends, and regulatory changes affecting government programs to enable data-driven planning and program adaptation.
Conducts data-driven analysis to foresee potential risks (e.g., regulatory disruptions) and emerging opportunities (e.g., AI-driven governance) for proactive policy adaptation and strategic decision-making. I identify and implement appropriate research methods and analytical approaches based on specific objectives.
I create preliminary hypotheses and research questions aligned with M/D/O objectives.
I make informed judgments based on relationships identified across information sources.

proficiency_levels.label: Designs organisation-wide research strategies, assures research quality, and leverages evidence to shape policy frameworks and governance reforms
proficiency_levels.description:
Develops comprehensive research strategies aligned with organisational priorities by assessing policy objectives, stakeholder needs, and regulatory frameworks and establishing clear execution roadmaps with timelines and reporting mechanisms.
Establishes protocols for sourcing, evaluating, and integrating diverse information streams, including stakeholder inputs, policy reports, and global best practices.
Reviews research findings for accuracy, credibility, and validity at an organisational level.
Leverage research insights to shape policy frameworks, drive structural reforms, and enhance governance efficiency.
Produces whitepapers, policy briefs, and research reports to inform policymakers, stakeholders, and the public.
Creates frameworks for evaluating research quality and impact.
Guides teams in selecting and applying appropriate research methodologies.
Establishes partnerships with research institutions and industry experts to conduct comprehensive primary and secondary research.
Develops systems for knowledge management and sharing. Integrates evidence-based decision-making across the organisation. I establish guidelines for research methodology and information management.
I establish partnerships with research institutions and industry experts.
I champion evidence-based decision-making across the organization.

theme_description: Demonstrates the ability to procure goods, services, or works using GeM (Government eMarketplace, National Public Procurement Portal) and other electronic portals, directly or through empanelled agencies, whether by way of purchase, lease, licence, or another method based on fundamental principles of transparency, fairness, competition, economy, efficiency, and accountability with respect to procurement. Ensures judicious use of public funds or any other source of funds (such as grants, loans, donations, or private investment), in accordance with GFR 2017, DFPR 1978 (DFPR Rule 21, 21(a), 21(b)), Manual of Procurement 2022 and their amendments, AOB, TOB, ToR.
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates practical knowledge and ability in leveraging GeM (Government eMarketplace) as per Rule 149 of GFR, 2017, for procurement of common use goods and services and uses its tools of e-bidding, reverse e-auction, and demand aggregation, Guideline on Government eMarketplace (GeM) for all procurement needs of the Ministry/Department/Organisation.

proficiency_levels.label: Understands foundational procurement processes and uses GeM for routine purchases in compliance with rules and guidelines
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands basic public procurement rules (e.g., GFR 2017, including Rule 149) and applies them to routine purchase cases within the Ministry/Department/Office (M/D/O) by using GeM to initiate transactions. Recognises fundamental procurement principles such as fair pricing, transparency, open competition, and non-discrimination, and consistently applies these principles in day-to-day GeM activities.
Understands and applies key tools used in GeM such as e-bidding, reverse e-auction, and demand aggregation to ensure meticulous and compliant maintenance of procurement documentation by accurately preparing, updating, and preserving key records such as indents, purchase orders, bid documents, inspection reports, and payment vouchers, in alignment with GFR 2017 (including Rule 149), DFPR 1978, Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) Guidelines, and GeM Buyer Guidelines.
Follows required procedures for secure recordkeeping and approval processes on GeM, ensuring vendor data confidentiality and adherence to audit protocols in all transactions.
Generates reports from GeM and maintains organised summaries of procurement timelines, expenditures, and vendor responses to monitor progress and support accountability.
Identifies common issues in GeM procurements (for example, receiving a single bid or encountering vague product specifications) and flags them to supervising authorities for guidance or escalation.
Coordinates with internal procurement and finance personnel to complete end-to-end GeM transactions, ensuring all necessary documents and approvals are in place for each purchase. Initiates simple e-bids on GeM by selecting appropriate bid templates, entering clear product specifications, uploading required documents, and publishing bids under supervision to invite vendor participation. I prepare and submit purchase requests on GeM by verifying that specifications, quantities, and categories comply with the department’s operational needs in line with approved technical standards and financial approvals.
I maintain records of procurement approvals, transactions, and vendor communications by organising documentation as per GFR 2017, CVC, and GeM requirements to support compliance.
I follow procedures for order placement, receipt verification, and payment initiation in GeM to ensure compliance with procurement rules, timely delivery, and transparent processing of payments.

proficiency_levels.label: Develops and executes structured GeM procurement plans to ensure transparency, value for money, and timely service delivery
proficiency_levels.description:
Designs and executes procurement workflows within GeM; including bid preparation, automated evaluation, vendor selection, and payments; ensuring compliance with GFR/DFPR and departmental mandates. Applies procurement planning to ensure purchases are cost-effective, timely, and aligned with programme objectives, approved budgets, and projected long-term needs.
Leverages GeM’s data and analytical tools to evaluate vendor performance (e.g. checking supplier ratings, past contract performance, compliance with terms) and uses these data-led insights to make informed decisions that optimise pricing, quality, and timely delivery of services.
Applies risk-mitigation and audit-readiness measures throughout the GeM procurement process, ensuring each step (bidding, selection, ordering, payment) complies with policy and can withstand scrutiny.
Prepares and validates procurement plans and bid documents to ensure clarity of scope, technical/financial alignment, and compliance with GFR/DFPR standards.
Coordinates with finance, audit, and technical teams to integrate their inputs and approvals before finalising procurement decisions on GeM.
Uses GeM’s dashboards, spend analysis, and vendor performance tools to monitor delivery timelines, cost efficiency, and contract compliance
Prepares and shares periodic procurement reports using GeM dashboards, transaction summaries, and expenditure statements to provide clear visibility on procurement progress, spending patterns, and compliance status. Provides guidance to colleagues on drafting tenders, monitoring vendor compliance, and effectively using digital procurement platforms such as GeM. I prepare bid documents and publish them on GeM with clear evaluation criteria and timelines.
I assess vendor bids using GeM tools, documenting the rationale for supplier selection and pricing decisions.
I monitor supplier performance and resolve delays or contract issues to keep procurements on schedule.

proficiency_levels.label: Shapes institutional procurement strategy and promotes digital-first, ethical, and transparent practices
proficiency_levels.description:
Guides teams to deploy advanced GeM features such as spend analysis, compliance dashboards, automated bid evaluation etc. and embeds their use into institutional procurement policy, ensuring that technology strengthens ethical standards, transparency, and accountability. Formulates medium-to long-term procurement strategies for the M/D/O, using GeM data, risk models, and cost analysis to align with programme objectives, fiscal prudence, and national procurement guidelines, while linking procurement outcomes to service delivery and citizen benefits.
Establishes institutional procurement standards by embedding automated checks, standard evaluation methods, and clear audit trails across GeM workflows, ensuring fairness, compliance, and readiness for scrutiny by auditors, parliamentary committees, and the public.
Promotes innovative procurement practices such as bulk-buying agreements, demand aggregation across M/D/Os, dynamic pricing, and startup marketplace adoption, engaging with vendors and industry bodies to generate cost savings, improve vendor diversity, and strengthen public value.
Builds monitoring and risk management systems by integrating dashboards, exception reports, and real-time tracking, anticipating risks in high-value or sensitive procurements, and ensuring proactive responses to audit and media scrutiny.
Advises senior leadership on procurement risks, market trends, and policy innovations by combining GeM insights with external market intelligence and audit findings, positioning the M/D/O as a leader in transparent, accountable procurement. Drives a shift from manual procurement to digital-first, transparent practices by institutionalising training programmes, building staff confidence in advanced GeM tools, and championing a culture of compliance, efficiency, and accountability. I formulate GeM procurement plans that optimise costs, leverage demand aggregation, and link purchases to programme and citizen outcomes.
I institutionalise audit-ready systems with automated checks, ethical safeguards, and monitoring tools to ensure transparency and accountability.
I promote digital-first procurement by mentoring teams, building capacity, and embedding sustainable and transparent practices across the organisation.

theme_description: Demonstrates thorough knowledge of the RTI Act, 2005, and promptly & appropriately handles RTI responses. Drives proper maintenance of RTI records to ensure procedural compliance as per the established rules. Provides assistance to person(s) seeking information, displaying transparency, good governance, and accountability.
sub_theme_description: Maintains departmental records of RTIs for effective and comprehensive public disclosure of information of the Department.

proficiency_levels.label: Maintains RTI records to ensure accurate, organised, and legally compliant responses to information requests
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands the significance of maintaining complete and accurate departmental records, including files, notes, emails, and other documents, to support timely responses to information seekers under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005.
Maintains RTI-related records as required under Section 4(1)(a) of the RTI Act, 2005, including applications, replies, appeals, and supporting documents, to ensure these are complete, organised, and easily accessible for information seekers.
Follows government-prescribed retention schedules for RTI records by storing documents for the legally specified period and securely disposing of obsolete files (through shredding or deletion) only after the assigned timeframe to support transparency and accountability in the M/D/O ’s record management practices.
Applies basic procedures for digitising appropriate RTI records, including scanning documents and saving them in designated folders or systems (such as e-Office, shared network drives or as guided by the Central Secretariat Manual of Office Procedures) in alignment with M/D/O guidelines.
Retrieves and provides copies of existing records when requested for RTI responses by confirming details with seniors to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
Records and updates new information accurately in physical and electronic registers to reduce the risk of missing or outdated files, and to avoid delayed RTI responses to information seekers.
Identifies and safeguards sensitive or confidential RTI records by applying basic security measures (locked cabinets, password-protected files) and supports the designated record officer (such as the Central Public Information Officer or other officially assigned staff) in maintaining record rooms or electronic folders to ensure records remain orderly, secure, and accessible. Organises and indexes RTI records using lists, registers, or electronic filing systems (such as subject-wise registers or e-Office) with clear labelling and traceability, following M/D/O filing systems, manuals, or the CSMoP to support easy retrieval for RTI responses. I maintain complete, organised, and accessible RTI records by accurately filing, digitising, and updating information in line with legal requirements and M/D/O procedures.
I securely store, classify, and protect sensitive RTI information by following filing systems and complying with retention schedules to ensure authorised access and transparency.
I retrieve, update, and dispose of RTI records accurately and timely by following M/D/O instructions to support clear responses to information seekers.

proficiency_levels.label: Manages RTI records and systems while guiding staff to ensure accessibility, compliance, and proactive disclosure of information
proficiency_levels.description:
Implements M/D/O guidelines to create detailed catalogues and indexes (such as file registers, spreadsheets, or electronic lists) with unique identifiers for RTI-related records to ensure records are well-organised and easily accessible to support effective public disclosure of information.
Ensures digitised storage of RTI records in folders or electronic systems by setting clear folder hierarchies and tags, reviewing naming conventions for easy search and access, while enabling efficient sharing and retrieval via shared drives with appropriate access controls to support timely RTI responses.
Facilitates review and updating of RTI records by planning team reviews, checking for outdated or incomplete files, communicating procedural changes, and ensuring that staff follow updated practices.
Analyses retention schedules to manage RTI record lifecycles by checking M/D/O records against government retention rules, tracking deadlines for review or disposal, keeping logs of actions taken, and ensuring compliance with legal requirements.
Coordinates proactive disclosure of information relevant to RTI by compiling and updating accurate details such as organisational structures, rules, and manuals to ensure this information is published across accessible channels, supporting effective public disclosure in line with the RTI Act, 2005 requirements.
Implements basic networking practices by establishing shared drives or networked folders with appropriate access controls, enabling staff to share and retrieve digitised records efficiently within the M/D/O to facilitate timely RTI responses.
Conducts routine backups of RTI records by planning and recording regular backup processes, checking that data can be restored when needed, and keeping backup copies secure to ensure records remain safe, complete, and accessible for effective public disclosure.
Guides the staff on RTI record management by developing training materials, demonstrating how to catalogue, index, and file records (including in electronic systems), and highlighting the importance of effective record keeping for RTI compliance. Reviews M/D/O’s RTI record keeping regularly by considering staff feedback and audit findings to ensure RTI filing systems remain organised, effective, and in line with the RTI Act, 2005; the Public Records Act, 1993; and current updated legal requirements. I implement department guidelines to organise RTI records by creating clear lists and labels to ensure easy access and sharing with the public.
I maintain digital RTI records by setting up clear folders, labeling files properly, controlling access, and keeping regular backups to make sharing information easy and accurate.
I guide record keeping by planning regular reviews, training staff, and following storage and sharing rules to support clear and complete public disclosure.

proficiency_levels.label: Designs RTI record management strategies to strengthen systems, ensure compliance, and enable transparent public disclosure of departmental information
proficiency_levels.description:
Designs RTI record management systems and secure networks to keep records easy to retrieve and share for timely and accurate responses to information seekers. Evaluates existing RTI record management practices by reviewing current records, storage, and retrieval methods to identify gaps, ensuring these meet record retention and security requirements.
Ensures RTI records across the department are digitised, indexed, and securely networked to enable effective and compliant information sharing with the public.
Establishes retention and disposal schedules for RTI records by setting timelines based on national guidelines (for e.g., retaining RTI applications without appeal for three years, those with appeals for five years, and preserving records related to policy matters or court judgments permanently or as specified), ensuring compliance with the RTI Act, 2005, and the Public Records Act, 1993.
Implements capacity building programs for staff on RTI record management by developing tailored curricula, integrating best practices, and utilising interactive learning methods, ensuring transparency, accountability, and citizen service under the RTI Act, 2005.
Establishes security measures for RTI records in both physical and electronic formats by using locked storage, encryption, regular backups, and controlled access to prevent unauthorised use, loss, or tampering.
Leads strategic reviews of departmental RTI record management policies and practices, aligning them with Section 4(1)(a) of the RTI Act, 2005, the Public Records Act, 1993, and integrates technological advancements to ensure effective public disclosure of information. Provides guidance to authorities and teams on enhancing transparency, accountability, and citizen responsiveness by recommending policy level improvements to RTI record management to ensure practices align with legal standards to support effective public disclosure. I design and improve RTI record systems by setting clear retention schedules and integrating technological advancements to ensure safe, accessible, and legally compliant public disclosure of information.
I coordinate M/D/O wide initiatives on digitisation and capacity building by anchoring training programs and embedding best practices that strengthen transparency, good governance, and accountability.
I advise leadership by reviewing current RTI record management policies, identifying gaps, and recommending policy level changes to strengthen transparency and citizen-centric service delivery.

theme_description: Collects, compiles, and assesses data, information, and knowledge resources in appropriate formats to enable interpretation and analysis for evidence-based decision-making. Scrutinises data and reports with a keen eye for detail, evaluates their accuracy, relevance, trends, and anomalies, extracts insights, and contextualises and critically analyses key points to develop data-driven strategic proposals and decisions while being mindful of prescribed rules & processes of data-handling within the government.
sub_theme_description: Represents data through the use of common graphics, such as charts, plots, infographics, and even animations for effective decision making through identification of patterns, trends, and correlations.

proficiency_levels.label: Understands foundational data analysis and visualisation principles
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands foundations of data analysis by exploring and formatting basic quantitative or categorical data (e.g., from HRMIS , survey responses) using predefined formats and operations (data cleaning, tabulation, labelling, etc.) to build reliable datasets for visual representation and further analysis. Uses simple graphics (bar, pie, line charts) using spreadsheet templates to present basic trends and comparisons, adding brief titles or captions to explain what the data shows, supporting clearer internal discussions.
Identifies and adds essential chart elements like legends, titles, and axis labels based on data reporting norms of the M/D/O to support accurate interpretation by team members.
Prepares data for visualisation by correcting common errors such as typos, blanks, and inconsistent formats, and applies basic formatting tools like colour scales and conditional formatting to highlight variations and make data more visually accessible.
Recognises and removes personally identifiable information from visual outputs to maintain confidentiality by applying data ethics principles (such as mitigating bias and promoting transparency) in data analysis and visualisation.
Organises and exports visuals (e.g., charts or animations made in tools such as PowerPoint) in accessible formats such as PDF or PPT to support clear and structured data access and presentation.
Recognises the role of data analysis and visualisation techniques, including basic charts, infographics, and introductory animations, in identifying trends and enabling informed decision making.
Identifies basic questions or problems from internal data by observing simple patterns, gaps, or anomalies, and suggests areas for further exploratory analysis. Uses foundational data exploration skills to examine categorical or numerical data and raises relevant questions to support team discussions and data reporting needs. I organise and clean basic datasets using spreadsheet tools to ensure accuracy and readiness for internal use.
I construct simple visuals (e.g., bar or pie charts) using predefined formats to support decision making.
I interpret basic patterns in data and align visuals with programme indicators to communicate key insights clearly, supporting internal discussions.

proficiency_levels.label: Applies data analysis and visualisation techniques to develop accurate, interpretable, and relevant outputs for monitoring and decision making
proficiency_levels.description:
Ensures quality assurance across data analysis and visualisation by validating cleaned datasets for completeness and consistency, and verifying outputs to support accurate, actionable insights for decision-making. Selects appropriate visual formats (e.g., stacked bars for group comparisons, line graphs for trends, scatter plots for correlations) by analysing data type, audience needs, and message, converting insights into visuals that support evidence-based decision-making.
Integrates datasets from multiple programme sources (e.g., staff attendance and service delivery records) through lookup or join operations to uncover trends, patterns, or correlations that enhance the quality and impact of data visualisation for decision-making.
Refines visualisations by integrating interpretive design and storytelling elements such as narrative titles, annotations, and guided sequences to frame key insights within programme context (e.g., linking decline in immunisation coverage to supply disruptions), helping teams understand trends, their causes, and implications for action.
Manages the design and deployment of dashboards using platforms like Tableau Public and Power BI to support real-time programme monitoring, progress tracking, and course correction.
Develops concise visual briefs combining key takeaways and dashboard snapshots, embedding them in programme notes or presentations to facilitate rapid interpretation and informed action by leadership.
Documents data sources, transformation logic, visualisation formulas, and assumptions to support transparent and replicable trend analysis by team members.
Applies organisational standards in data visualisation by using programme indicators (e.g., dropout rates, medicine stockouts) to ensure visuals align with dashboards and reporting requirements.
Validates datasets systematically, applies consistent templates, and documents data sources to embed QA practices in data analysis and visualisation, ensuring outputs are accurate, transparent, and aligned with institutional standards. Distils complex datasets into strategic insights for inclusion in white papers, policy notes, and leadership briefs, informing M/D/O-wide planning and resource allocation. I validate data sources and check for completeness, consistency, and accuracy to ensure high-quality outputs within the M/D/O.
I analyse datasets and apply appropriate visual formats based on data type and intended message to present trends, comparisons, and correlations that strengthen reviews and support informed decision-making.
I synthesise analysed data into clear visual summaries that highlight key patterns and insights, ensuring outputs are transparent, replicable, and tailored to programme decision-making needs.

proficiency_levels.label: Drives the institutionalisation of data analysis and visualisation practices to generate strategic insights, inform policy, and build technical capacity across the M/D/O
proficiency_levels.description:
Embeds advanced QA frameworks by embedding internal standards for data analysis and visualisation, mentoring teams to conduct QA/QC checks before outputs reach leadership, and strengthening organisational capacity through coaching on advanced data storytelling principles (e.g., visual hierarchy, logical flow, audience targeting) to ensure high-quality data analysis and visualisation practices across the outputs Embeds advanced practices for analysis and visuals (e.g., correlation plots, network diagrams, geographic heat maps) using tools such as R, Python (Plotly, Seaborn), and guides their application to reveal complex relationships in data for strategic decisions.
Champions adoption of dashboards (e.g., for grievance redressal via CPGRAMS , service delivery trackers such as Poshan Tracker for ICDS , HMIS ) to ensure data integration into decision making processes within the M/D/O.
Guides the distillation of complex datasets into clear, accurate, and well-structured insights by applying QA/QC practices, ensuring outputs (e.g., briefing notes, dashboards, summaries) are strategically planned, consistently formatted, and consumable for decision-makers across the M/D/O. Collaborates with technical experts to co-develop multidimensional visualisations (e.g., gender-disaggregated indicators, service equity matrices) that promote inclusive, evidence-based, and targeted policy interventions within the M/D/O. I embed advanced data analysis and visualisation practices to inform strategic and policy-level decisions.
I institutionalise data analysis and visualisation standards and mentor teams to strengthen internal capacity for high-quality, audience-appropriate storytelling using data.
I establish data quality protocols and review mechanisms, ensuring data analysis visualisations reflect accurate, timely, and verified data.

theme_description: Understands, identifies, implements, and utilises digital tools for accurate, speedy, and effective delivery for superior visualisation and decision-making at different levels of the organisation. Leverages digital technologies and platforms to collaborate effectively and efficiently with multiple stakeholders.
sub_theme_description: Applies AI/ML tools to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of government systems while ensuring citizen-centric service delivery. Evaluates data readiness, deploys context-appropriate AI/ML solutions, and mitigates risks, biases, and security threats by following ethical, legal, and organisational protocols. Drives organisational adoption and transformation by mentoring personnel, fostering innovation, and collaborating with ecosystem stakeholders to co-create and scale responsible AI/ML solutions.

proficiency_levels.label: Understands basic uses, risks, and ethics of AI/ML in governance
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands basic AI/ML concepts and their possible uses and limitations in governance. Understands the risks and limitations of AI-assisted tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Co-Pilot), including algorithmic bias (e.g., prejudice, underrepresentation, legacy patterns), privacy and security risks, and the legal and ethical considerations for their use in day-to-day work.
Demonstrates awareness of AI tools and platforms (for instance, cloud-based ML platforms (e.g., TensorFlow, Amazon SageMaker), AI-assisted productivity tools (e.g., Co-Pilot, ChatGPT), and public sector tools (e.g., Bhashini, AskDISHA 2.0, etc.,) developed across M/D/Os to deliver digital public goods, promote citizen-centric and efficient public service delivery.
Shows basic awareness of AI-enabled functionalities such as sentiment analysis, text summarisation, machine translation, image classification, speech-to-text conversion, and predictive analytics, and can identify relevant use-cases for day-to-day operations.
Interprets global and national trends in AI adoption, ethics, and governance (e.g., responsible AI principles, Digital India initiatives, Smart Cities mission, etc) and relates them to emerging uses in the public sector.
Recognises AI/ML use in Indian governance ecosystems, such as Aadhaar-enabled services, India Urban Data Exchange, and other digital public goods, while being able to generalise these to broader categories of AI-enabled governance. Adheres to organisational protocols and security measures related to AI integration, ensuring safe and compliant use. I understand basic AI/ML concepts, their appropriate use, potential risks, and legal and ethical considerations in government contexts.
I demonstrate awareness of AI/ML tools and their applications in governance, including tasks like image recognition, text translation, and examples from national initiatives.
I recognise potential risks, biases, and security threats when using AI/ML tools and follow established protocols to minimise risks and ensure compliance.

proficiency_levels.label: Applies AI/ML knowledge to assess data readiness, deploy context-specific solutions, and build team capacity for responsible use within the M/D/O
proficiency_levels.description:
Applies understanding of the AI/ML landscape to evaluate data readiness, deploy contextual solutions, and guide teams to acquire relevant competencies within the M/D/O.
Demonstrates a clear understanding of AI models (e.g., supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning, etc), their lifecycle (development, deployment, adoption), technical capabilities, limitations, and societal implications.
Analyses potential use of AI/ML platforms (e.g., AskDISHA 2.0, India Urban Data Exchange (IUDX), Bhashini and other AI-enabled citizen engagement tools) to deliver context-specific solutions such as automation, predictive analytics, and multilingual translation.
Assesses implications of AI-led transformation on workflows and modifies these to changing requirements and bridge competency gaps in AI/ML tool usage.
Supports team learning by introducing accessible AI/ML tools and practices for day-to-day tasks.
Communicates AI/ML insights and challenges effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Deploys AI/ML systems in the M/D/O and monitors them using Human-in-the-Loop mechanisms (e.g., officers reviewing AI outputs before final decisions), audits, or similar safeguards to address bias, adversarial use, and compliance concerns.
Evaluates organisational datasets for quality, completeness, and representativeness to determine readiness for AI/ML integration. Ensures AI/ML deployments comply with legal and ethical standards (e.g., DPDP Act , Responsible AI principles). I assess system, process, and data readiness within the M/D/O to enable effective and responsible use of AI/ML tools.
I deploy and monitor AI/ML solutions with safeguards, adapting workflows and ensuring alignment with ethical, legal, and organisational protocols.
I mentor personnel on AI/ML concepts and tools, communicating insights clearly and building a competent, AI-enabled workforce.

proficiency_levels.label: Guides the adoption AI systems in the M/D/O by ensuring appropriate safeguards, skills, and ethical standards are in place
proficiency_levels.description:
Ensures AI/ML adoption in the M/D/O complies with ethical, legal, and operational frameworks (e.g., India AI Mission, Principles for Responsible Management of AI Systems, National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy, etc) and integrates risk-mitigation measures to address bias, security, and ethical concerns. Manages AI-associated risks through risk assessments, policy compliance checks, and implementation of safeguards addressing bias, security, and ethical considerations.
Encourages pilots and sandbox approaches for responsible experimentation with AI/ML tools within policy/organisation limits.
Manages targeted capacity building programs to bridge personnel competency gaps and enable proactive adoption of AI-based solutions for digital transformation.
Drives organisational change management to gradually integrate AI and digital workflows, enhancing internal efficiency and citizen-focused service delivery.
Builds partnerships with ecosystem stakeholders - including government and policy bodies, academia, industry, startups, and citizen-facing platforms (for e.g., NeGD, IITs, Microsoft Azure, Niki.ai, IUDC, etc) - to co-create and scale responsible AI solutions Guides the formulation of governance, regulatory, and operational frameworks for AI deployment by anticipating implications of emerging technologies and collaborating with stakeholders and experts. I guide the strategic adoption of AI/ML tools in my M/D/O, ensuring alignment with ethical, legal, and operational frameworks and integrating risk-mitigation measures.
I enable organisational transformation by fostering innovation, piloting responsible AI, and building team capacity for citizen-centric AI/ML deployment.
I build partnerships with government bodies, academia, industry, startups, and citizen-facing platforms to co-create, scale, and responsibly deploy AI solutions.

theme_description: Demonstrates comprehension of the significance of Cabinet Notes in policymaking, where the Cabinet and its committees make vital decisions that are crucial for efficient governance. This includes the ability to prepare Cabinet Notes that address various national and international matters affecting different areas of governance and present them to the Cabinet for consideration and decision-making. Therefore, a deep understanding of the AoB Rules, 1961 & ToB Rules, 1961 is essential, along with exceptional skills in preparing comprehensive Cabinet Notes that provide pertinent details and the right perspective.
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates a high level of proficiency in conducting the official business of the Government of India, as specified in the first schedule of the Allocation of Business Rules (AoB), 1961, which define the Ministries, Departments, Secretariats, and offices where the government business is transacted and outline the distribution of subjects among various departments, as specified in the second schedule of the rules. Demonstrates comprehension of the Transaction of Business (ToB) Rules, 1961, which outline the procedures for handling the business of the Government of India, including consultation with other departments and submission of cases to the Prime Minister, Cabinet and its Committees, and the President.

proficiency_levels.label: Applies AoB and ToB Rules to process routine cases and support Cabinet submissions
proficiency_levels.description:
Identifies the correct Ministry/Department/Organisation (M/D/O) and subject allocation as per the AoB Schedules to route files accurately and avoid misclassification. Understands the purpose, structure, and key provisions of the AoB and ToB Rules to follow prescribed procedures for official business.
Assists in preparing routine Cabinet Notes, memoranda, and background notes using standard formats and checklists to ensure completeness.
Applies basic ToB requirements for inter-ministerial consultation by circulating drafts to concerned M/D/Os within stipulated timelines.
Maintains records of consultations, approvals, and references to rules in files and e-office systems to ensure traceability
Verifies that proposals include required annexures, financial implications, and legal vetting notes as per ToB Rules to avoid procedural deficiencies.
Flags cases requiring higher-level approval or escalation to supervisors when rule interpretation is unclear to prevent procedural lapses. Uses approved digital platforms (for e.g., e-Office, Cabinet Secretariat portals, etc) to track movement and status of cases for timely processing. I route files and proposals correctly by referring to the AoB schedules.
I support the preparation of Cabinet Notes by following the prescribed formats and procedures.
I ensure consultations and records are completed as required under the ToB Rules.

proficiency_levels.label: Applies AoB/ToB Rules to manage inter-ministerial coordination and ensure procedurally sound Cabinet submissions
proficiency_levels.description:
Interprets AoB provisions to resolve jurisdictional issues and clarify responsibility among M/D/Os for complex proposals Applies ToB Rules to determine the appropriate level of approval (for e.g., Minister, Cabinet Committee, Cabinet, Prime Minister, or President) for different categories of cases to ensure procedural correctness.
Manages inter-ministerial consultations by identifying relevant stakeholders, synthesising comments, and reconciling divergent views to strengthen proposals.
Reviews Cabinet Notes for compliance with AoB/ToB Rules, ensuring inclusion of financial, legal, and implementation implications to support informed decision making
Drafts reasoned notes explaining procedural choices, consultation outcomes, and rule-based justifications to enable defensible submissions.
Coordinates with Finance, Law, and Cabinet Secretariat to resolve procedural gaps and ensure alignment with established practices.
Monitors timelines and milestones for Cabinet submissions and Committee notes to ensure adherence to ToB-prescribed processes. Guides junior staff on the correct application of AoB/ToB Rules and common procedural pitfalls to improve overall quality and consistency. I manage inter-ministerial consultations and resolve jurisdictional issues using AoB/ToB Rules.
I ensure Cabinet Notes are procedurally complete, compliant, and decision ready
I guide teams and document rule-based justifications for Cabinet submissions.

proficiency_levels.label: Guides AoB/ToB application and strengthens institutional practices for complex Cabinet processes
proficiency_levels.description:
Advises senior leadership on complex AoB/ToB interpretations, including exceptional cases involving multiple Ministries, sensitive subjects, or constitutional authorities. Directs preparation and vetting of high impact Cabinet and Cabinet Committee proposals to ensure strict adherence to procedural, constitutional, and governance requirements.
Assesses implications of amendments to AoB/ToB Rules or evolving Cabinet Secretariat instructions on departmental workflows and recommends institutional adaptations.
Institutionalises SOPs, templates, and guidance notes for Cabinet Note preparation and inter-ministerial consultations to standardise best practices.
Engages with the Cabinet Secretariat and other central agencies to resolve precedents, clarify procedures, and strengthen coordination mechanisms.
Oversees quality assurance of Cabinet submissions, ensuring accuracy, neutrality, and completeness to safeguard collective decision making.
Mentors officers and builds organisational capacity in Cabinet procedures, rule interpretation, and strategic handling of government business. Anticipates procedural risks or bottlenecks in Cabinet processes and introduces preventive controls to maintain efficiency and credibility. I provide authoritative advice on AoB/ToB application for complex cases.
I institutionalise robust systems and SOPs for high quality Cabinet Note preparation.
I build organisational capability to manage Cabinet processes efficiently and compliantly.

theme_description: Demonstrates expertise in managing various processes and procedures related to establishment and human resource management, including manpower planning for efficient and optimal staffing, as well as managing service and personnel matters such as holding DPCs, managing promotions, pay fixation, allowances, transfers, postings, deputations, resignations, retirement, pension papers, employee grievances, reservations for various cadres, grades, and groups of services, and preventing sexual harassment within the Department or Ministry. Recognizes the accountability to provide prompt, accurate, and concise responses to employee queries by referring comprehensively to various FRSR, related rules, acts, policies, executive orders, etc., to satisfy government employees and mitigate factors that could lead to grievances or administrative tribunal cases.
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates the ability to administer and implement reservation policies in appointments, promotions, and service matters in accordance with government instructions. This includes preparing and maintaining accurate reservation rosters, applying prescribed relaxations or concessions in age, fees, and qualifications, and ensuring representation for Scheduled Castes (SCs), Scheduled Tribes (STs), Other Backward Classes (OBCs), Persons with Disabilities (PwDs), Ex-servicemen (including re-employment in central services and posts), and Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs). The competency also covers interpreting amendments, circulars, and judicial pronouncements related to reservations, updating procedures accordingly, and ensuring compliance across cadres, services, and posts within the Ministry/Department/Organization. It emphasizes fairness, transparency, and accountability in managing reservations, while addressing shortfalls, backlogs, and audit requirements through timely monitoring and reporting.

proficiency_levels.label: Applies foundational understanding of reservation rules to routine HR cases under supervision
proficiency_levels.description:
Identifies constitutional provisions and basic Government of India instructions governing reservations for SC, ST, OBC, PwD, EWS, and Ex-servicemen (for e.g., (e.g., Articles 16(4) and 16(4A) of the Constitution, EWS reservation guidelines, PwD reservation instructions under the RPwD Act, etc).
Understands the purpose and structure of post-based reservation rosters and recognises their relevance in recruitment and promotion cases.
Applies DoPT instructions (for e.g., post-based roster OMs, reservation instructions for recruitment/promotion, backlog vacancy guidelines, etc) to routine appointment and promotion cases by following prescribed checklists and formats under guidance.
Prepares and updates reservation rosters using approved formats (for e.g., manual or eHRMS/Excel-based) with attention to detail.
Records relaxations and concessions (for e.g., age, qualification, fees, etc) strictly as per notified rules (for e.g., e.g., DoPT age-relaxation instructions, PwD and EWS reservation guidelines, recruitment rules/examination notifications, etc) and maintains supporting documentation.
Processes files through e-Office, ensuring correct noting, drafting, and placement of approvals related to reservation matters.
Maintains systematic records to support RTI responses and audit scrutiny, escalating ambiguities or deviations for guidance. Demonstrates awareness of fairness, non-discrimination, and transparency as core principles underpinning reservation implementation. I accurately maintain reservation rosters using prescribed formats and tools.
I process routine recruitment and promotion cases by correctly applying reservation rules under supervision.
I maintain complete and traceable documentation for concessions, relaxations, and approvals.

proficiency_levels.label: Manages and monitors reservation compliance across cadres through analysis, coordination, and corrective action
proficiency_levels.description:
Validates reservation rosters across groups, cadres, and services using prescribed verification protocols (for e.g., DoPT post-based roster checks, cadre strength–roster reconciliation, pre-DPC roster validation, etc) to ensure correct representation.
Monitors appointments, promotions, and application of relaxations and concessions to ensure compliance with DoPT/Ministry of Finance guidelines across recruitment, promotion, and service-related cases.
Manages and validates reservation rosters across groups, cadres, and services to ensure proper representation across vertical and horizontal reservation categories (for e.g., SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PwD, Ex-servicemen, etc).
Interprets amendments, clarifications, and court directions related to reservation policies and applies them consistently to ongoing cases.
Coordinates with recruitment agencies, cadre controlling authorities, administrative divisions, and audit/vigilance units to ensure end-to-end compliance.
Analyses cadre-wise data to identify shortfalls, backlogs, and deviations (for e.g., shortfall in SC/ST/OBC/PwD representation against prescribed percentages, backlog vacancies due to unfilled reserved posts, deviations from post-based roster points or cadre strength, etc) and initiates corrective actions in consultation with stakeholders.
Prepares consolidated reports on reservation status, backlog vacancies, and representation trends using MIS or dashboards for senior officers and DPCs.
Responds to audit observations and RTI queries on reservation matters by providing accurate, rule-based, and well-documented replies. Implements feedback from audits, grievances, and court cases to improve reservation processes and prevent recurrence of errors. I ensure reservation rosters and HR actions comply with rules across cadres and services.
I apply government clarifications and judicial directions accurately to complex reservation cases.
I provide reliable reservation status and backlog reports to support informed decision making.

proficiency_levels.label: Provides institutional oversight and guidance on reservation governance and compliance
proficiency_levels.description:
Designs and institutionalises frameworks for reservation governance, including standardised roster validation SOPs, cadre-level reservation review cycles, backlog and shortfall monitoring mechanisms, and escalation protocols for non-compliance or disputes.
Evaluates M/D/O practices against constitutional provisions, DoPT instructions, and judicial pronouncements to ensure sustained compliance.
Provides interpretation and resolution in complex, disputed, or litigation-prone reservation matters (for e.g., promotion related reservation disputes, backlog vacancy carry forward, seniority issues, or horizontal reservation application, etc).
Anticipates legal, audit, and reputational risks arising from reservation implementation and ensures decisions are legally defensible and auditable.
Oversees system-level monitoring of cadre representation, backlogs, and compliance through dashboards and periodic reviews.
Strengthens transparency and trust by ensuring proactive disclosures, timely reporting, and consistent handling of reservation-related grievances.
Advises leadership on strategic HR and manpower planning implications of reservation policies and representation trends. I provide guidance on complex and disputed reservation matters.
I ensure M/D/O-wide compliance with reservation policies, court rulings, and audit requirements.
I strengthen equitable representation and institutional credibility through system-level oversight.

theme_description: Demonstrates expertise in managing various processes and procedures related to establishment and human resource management, including manpower planning for efficient and optimal staffing, as well as managing service and personnel matters such as holding DPCs, managing promotions, pay fixation, allowances, transfers, postings, deputations, resignations, retirement, pension papers, employee grievances, reservations for various cadres, grades, and groups of services, and preventing sexual harassment within the Department or Ministry. Recognizes the accountability to provide prompt, accurate, and concise responses to employee queries by referring comprehensively to various FRSR, related rules, acts, policies, executive orders, etc., to satisfy government employees and mitigate factors that could lead to grievances or administrative tribunal cases.
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates understanding of the Annual Performance Assessment Report process for each Government employee, enabling evaluation of performance and determining their suitability for career progression opportunities such as confirmation, promotion, selection for deputation, or selection for foreign assignments.

proficiency_levels.label: Understands the APAR process and accurately routes and records appraisal documents
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands the purpose of APAR in assessing performance and its linkage to confirmation, promotion, deputation, and other service matters.
Follows the APAR workflow (self‑appraisal, reporting, reviewing, acceptance, disclosure) in SPARROW, e‑APAR or eOffice, and checks mandatory fields before routing to reduce returns.
Applies the correct DoPT-prescribed APAR formats and file nomenclature to ensure standardised and traceable appraisal records.
Maintains basic APAR entries, checklists, and supporting documents (for e.g., self-appraisal, reporting officer remarks, and supporting documents uploaded in SPARROW/e-APAR, etc) as instructed.
Verifies basic completeness (for e.g., reporting period, leave, work outputs, achievements, identity details, etc) against the prescribed form to ensure the APAR is action‑ready.
Collates and organises APARs (for e.g., essential records APARs of the prescribed period, posting/role orders, leave details affecting the appraisal year, training records, service profile from HRMS , etc) and checks basic completeness for career progression assessments.
Executes APAR digital systems (for e.g., HRMS e-APAR modules, SPARROW, eOffice, etc) to upload, route, and track appraisal records with guidance. Identifies and rectifies APAR discrepancies (for e.g., missing mandatory entries, incorrect appraisal period details, stage-wise delays in SPARROW, etc) while maintaining confidentiality and proper file management. I understand the purpose, stages, and timelines of the APAR process.
I accurately route, upload, and track APARs in SPARROW/e-APAR using prescribed formats and checklists.
I maintain confidential, complete, and retrieval-ready APAR records. .

proficiency_levels.label: Validates and analyses APAR records to support fair and timely performance decisions
proficiency_levels.description:
Reviews and validates APAR forms by checking rules, timelines, and key entries against DoPT guidelines (for e.g., self-appraisal details, reporting officer remarks, disclosure dates, etc) to ensure readiness for performance evaluation.
Runs quality checks for grading inconsistencies and computes overall grades using a worksheet so that errors are prevented before the DPC scrutiny.
Compiles appraisal data from digital systems (for e.g., HRMS e-APAR modules, SPARROW, eOffice) to maintain updated records for decisions on confirmation, promotion, deputation, or foreign assignments of officials.
Coordinates with reporting and reviewing authorities to close documentation gaps, maintain confidentiality and access controls, and ensure APARs move smoothly through each stage of the process.
Processes APAR representations as per procedure by compiling relevant facts, timelines, and applicable precedents to support fair consideration.
Prepares clear note-sheets that summarise performance highlights, pending entries, and identified risks to support rule-based decisions on confirmation, promotion, deputation, or foreign assignment.
Generates section‑level dashboards from SPARROW/eOffice showing stage‑wise pendency, disclosure status and ageing.
Applies data‑protection practices (for e.g., need‑to‑know sharing, redaction of personal data, secure links, etc) when circulating APAR extracts to protect privacy. Analyses delay patterns (for e.g., repeated pendency at reporting or reviewing stages in specific sections, delays linked to particular roles or controlling officers, end-of-year or pre-DPC backlog spikes, etc) and proposes fixes (for e.g., calendarised SPARROW reminders, predefined APAR completion windows, pre-DPC/APAR completion clinics, etc) to improve timeliness and reduce grievances. I validate APARs for completeness, consistency, and timeliness to ensure they are decision-ready for career progression.
I analyse APAR data and dashboards to identify delays, gaps, or risks and take corrective action.
I process representations and prepare note sheets that support fair, rule-based decisions.

proficiency_levels.label: Oversees the APAR framework to ensure consistency, fairness, and legal defensibility
proficiency_levels.description:
Evaluates complex APAR cases (for e.g., conflicting remarks, overdue submissions, exceptional achievements, disputed gradings, etc) and interprets applicable rules to ensure fair, accurate, and defensible performance assessments.
Guides reporting and reviewing authorities on applying APAR rules and updated Government instructions (for e.g., revised timelines, competency frameworks, disclosure procedures, etc) to ensure consistent implementation across the M/D/O.
Institutionalises digital appraisal record systems (for e.g., HRMS dashboards and eOffice reports) by standardising APAR lifecycle controls (submission, disclosure, representation, retention) within HRMS/SPARROW workflows to ensure sustained availability of complete and up-to-date information for career progression decisions.
Analyses departmental APAR trends (for e.g., repeated delays, documentation gaps, scoring inconsistencies, etc) and embeds identified best practices and process improvements to strengthen timeliness, accountability, and overall appraisal quality.
Provides advice to DPCs by identifying gaps or issues in APAR records that could affect the defensibility of promotion and selection decisions.
Conducts periodic APAR audits and translates findings into targeted process improvements to strengthen timeliness and appraisal quality.
Partners with digital HR systems and IT support units on SPARROW/HRMS enhancements to improve compliance, privacy, and retrieval. Aligns APAR insights with learning, development and workforce planning so that performance feedback informs capacity building and deployment. I institutionalise APAR governance mechanisms that ensure consistency, fairness, and compliance across the M/D/O.
I provide legally defensible APAR dossiers and risk advice to leadership and DPCs.
I use audits, metrics, and trend analysis to resolve systemic gaps and strengthen appraisal quality and timeliness.

theme_description: Demonstrates knowledge and ability to identify, define, plan, develop, deliver & monitor government programs, schemes to realise the agreed benefits for the citizens within the prescribed timeframe. Oversees and coordinates a group of related projects within a government program to achieve specific benefits and maintain control. Demonstrates the ability in Program Selection, Program Planning, Program/ Project Transitions, Program Implementation, Strategic Program Management, Program Progress Monitoring and Review, Program Analysis, Program Financing, Program/Project Change Management, Benefits Management, Stakeholder Relationships and Collaboration.
sub_theme: Research and Need Analysis - Government Program Formulation
