sub_theme_description: Analyses relevant reports, surveys, papers, etc. to identify the needs, the beneficiaries, returns or strategic benefits to the citizens and the Nation at large (both in tangible and intangible terms).

proficiency_levels.label: Gathers and organises research to identify citizen needs and program objectives
proficiency_levels.description:
Gathers data from internal and external sources (for e.g., census reports, NSSO surveys, previous program evaluations, RBI bulletins, Ministry annual reports, etc) to understand the program context and citizen need. Organises data, reports, surveys, papers using standard frameworks (for e.g., PESTEL, RACI, etc) to enable structured analysis of citizen needs, beneficiaries, and potential program outcomes.
Identifies target beneficiaries and their key needs by analysing data from sources such as surveys, evaluations, or government reports (for e.g., census, NSSO, RBI bulletins, etc) to ensure that program design is evidence-based and citizen-focused.
Assesses expected tangible (for e.g., enrolment rates, income growth, etc) and intangible outcomes (for e.g., improved trust, safety, wellbeing) to understand how proposed programs will contribute to citizen welfare and national priorities.
Assesses trends and patterns in qualitative and quantitative data, categorising data and information, identifying gaps, conducting correlation analysis, etc, to support evidence-based conclusions.
Documents findings using standard tools (for e.g., eOffice, MS Excel, dashboards, prescribed reporting templates, etc) ensuring accuracy and traceability. Summarises research findings and insights clearly for stakeholders (for e.g., citizens, civil society groups, private firms, political leadership, etc) in prescribed formats to support evidence-based decision-making. I collect relevant data and information from internal and external sources to understand program context and citizen needs.
I analyse data using standard frameworks to identify beneficiaries, key needs, and potential program outcomes.
I prepare concise research briefs that support evidence-based program decisions.

proficiency_levels.label: Synthesises data to develop evidence-based and risk-informed program proposals
proficiency_levels.description:
Integrates qualitative and quantitative data from multiple sources (for e.g., surveys, MIS dashboards, PFMS expenditure trends, evaluation studies, etc) to identify implementation gaps and emerging needs, informing program design. Evaluates reliability, limitations, and assumptions of datasets (for e.g., reviews survey methodology and sample size, checks recency and completeness of MIS data, cross-verifies PFMS figures with utilisation reports, etc) before drawing conclusions.
Applies analytical frameworks such as cost-benefit analysis, SROI, LogFrame, MCDA, etc, to articulate both tangible and intangible benefits to citizens and the nation.
Builds team capacity in using structured analytical tools (for e.g., Cost-Benefit Analysis, LogFrame, MIS analysis, etc) to strengthen evidence-based program design.
Uses data analytics and visualisation tools (for e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Office, etc) to generate evidence and ensures their effective adoption by team members to support data-driven decision-making for new programs or schemes.
Coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to expand information sources, validate data, and ground-truth findings, ensuring research reflects operational realities.
Synthesises findings to clearly define target beneficiary groups, estimate the scale of needs, and prioritise research investment in line with likely impact on policy and citizen outcomes.
Analyses the external environment for emerging trends (for e.g., climate change, technological disruptions, socio-economic shifts, etc) and policy developments (for e.g., new regulations, budgetary announcements, international commitments, etc) to assess their implications for program relevance, feasibility, and strategic benefits to citizens and the nation. Develops program proposals based on evidence from research and need analysis, clearly identifying potential risks (for e.g., implementation bottlenecks, changing market conditions, etc.) and opportunities (for e.g., leveraging new technology, synergies with other schemes, etc.) to ensure robust, feasible, and citizen-focused program design. I synthesise multi-source evidence to define priority needs and beneficiary segments.
I assess data quality, apply structured analysis, and define priority beneficiaries and program outcomes.
I develop evidence-based program proposals that address citizen needs, minimise risks, and improve service delivery outcomes.

proficiency_levels.label: Leads research and needs assessments to guide program decisions and maximise citizen impact
proficiency_levels.description:
Leads comprehensive need assessments for major programs by integrating economic, social, technological, fiscal, and operational analyses to inform decision making, and ensuring alignment with national priorities (for e.g., Viksit Bharat@2047, Aatmanirbhar Bharat, Make in India, etc).
Critically reviews large-scale datasets, evaluation findings, and expenditure patterns (for e.g., PFMS, OOMF dashboards, sectoral MIS, etc) to identify structural gaps and high impact intervention areas.
Evaluates projected public value, cost-effectiveness, and long-term citizen impact of proposed programs before approval or scale-up.
Validates assumptions, risk assessments, and beneficiary targeting logic in program proposals to ensure robustness and practicality.
Ensures that program proposals clearly articulate tangible and intangible citizen benefits, distributional impact, and measurable outcomes for effective citizen service delivery.
Reviews compliance with data governance norms and ethical standards while using advanced analytics tools for decision support.
Engages with inter-ministerial, subject-matter experts, senior decision-makers, international organisations and governments to foster new research agendas, validate findings, and incorporate multi-dimensional perspectives into program design. Presents research findings in inter-ministerial meetings, conferences, or policy forums and contributes policy papers or briefs to strengthen evidence-based program decisions. I lead complex research assessments to identify high-impact program priorities and citizen benefit areas.
I critically evaluate program proposals to ensure feasibility, cost-effectiveness, and measurable public value.
I collaborate with ministries, experts, and partners to validate evidence and strengthen program design.

theme_description: Demonstrates ability to plan phases/stages and identify key activities, dependencies, and milestones for driving projects. Utilises & creates various standard frameworks/mechanisms to determine project mode, vendor selection & engagement, implementation, communication, knowledge transition, and risk mitigation. Evaluates progress against KPIs and ensures adherence to relevant guidelines & policies etc., for ensuring optimisation of resource utilisation, and driving realisation of intended benefit for the intended audience.
sub_theme_description: Evaluate project progress with respect to contractual obligations and various parameters like, governance, communication management, standardisation, Crisis Management Plan, Project Risk Management, Integrated Risk Management, HSE Bottom Line, DCMA 14-point Schedule Health Check, fund release & utilisation, Sustainability (like, Biodegradable, Carbon footprint, Dematerialisation, Design for the Environment (DfE), Environmentally preferable products (EPP), Life-Cycle Assessment (LCA) etc.), Governance Risks, Statutory Risks, Contractual Risks, Operational Risks, Social Bottom Line etc. Proposes necessary adjustments to implementation timelines, utilising efficient and economical methods to accelerate progress.

proficiency_levels.label: Interprets compliance status of schemes/programs across parameters using prescribed evaluatory frameworks
proficiency_levels.description:
Demonstrates working knowledge of commonly used government evaluation frameworks (for e.g., basic risk management, crisis management plans, fund utilisation norms, sustainability concepts, etc) and correctly identifies their core components and purpose. Recognises the project objectives and their alignment with M/D/O goals, enabling accurate tracking of activities, phases, risks, and compliance requirements.
Identifies and relates essential sustainability concepts (for e.g., biodegradable materials, carbon footprint, Life-Cycle Assessment, etc) within project evaluation contexts.
Interprets risk management principles to identify and categorise potential risks (governance, financial, operational, environmental, and statutory) in projects.
Interprets the DCMA 14-Point Assessment and understands the significance of each metric (for e.g., Logic Checks, Leads and Lags, Relationship Types, etc) for effectively tracking project implementation.
Extracts and consolidates key clauses, milestones, timelines, scope of work, and obligations from approved contracts and sanction documents to prepare a structured summary of compliance status for internal review.
Conducts primary data collection using standard tools such as KIIs, FGDs , etc, based on defined SOP /methodology in the organisation.
Reconciles fund releases and utilisation in PFMS against sanction orders and milestone certificates, to inform approvals, fund release, resequencing, or corrective action.
Uses prescribed templates and tools (for e.g., checklists, purchase/work order logs, e-Office, etc) to record compliance status, non-conformities, and evaluation findings, as per defined timelines, in a single auditable source for evaluations. I interpret and document project compliance status across contractual, financial, risk, sustainability, and governance parameters using prescribed frameworks.
I track fund utilisation, schedule health, identify risks, and flag deviations accurately using standard tools and systems.
I maintain clear, auditable evaluation records to support internal review and monitoring of schemes and programmes.

proficiency_levels.label: Synthesises evaluation findings to identify bottlenecks and recommend evidence-based corrections
proficiency_levels.description:
Synthesises evaluation findings across parameters using leading/lagging indicators, against statutory norms to identify emerging and persistent implementation bottlenecks. Identifies patterns of persistent non-compliance, escalates persistent breaches, analyses root causes, and manages coordinated corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
Contextualises survey tools and toolkits to project needs and builds the capacity of team member(s) to effectively use resources, including CAPI based data-collection applications.
Reviews projects regularly by using frameworks such as DCMA 14-point criteria, DMEO’s REESI+E framework, utilising trackers, MIS and project dashboards to manage the project objectives and obligations effectively.
Analyses interdependencies across regulatory, contractual, financial, and operational risks (for e.g., approval delays affecting milestone payments or contractual deviations creating compliance exposure) to manage cascading impacts and maintain statutory and contractual compliance.
Synthesises the project status across regulatory and financial compliance parameters, by identifying sequencing inefficiencies, analysing root causes for the deviations and drawing comparisons with project schedules, PFMS data, meeting trackers, risk logs, and incident reports.
Assesses trade-offs between time, cost, quality, and risk while developing feasible, economical recommendations such as resequencing, parallel execution, milestone-linked payments, or fund rationalisation.
Develops the communication plan for periodical cadence, stakeholder roles and responsibilities, and issues log tracking, to sustain alignment.
Uses evaluation findings to inform scheme redesign, scale-up, rationalisation, or discontinuation decisions in alignment with public interest and policy priorities. I evaluate projects to detect deviations early and support timely corrective action.
I support teams and stakeholders by contextualising evaluation tools, and enabling consistent application.
I develop evidence-based recommendations by analysing governance, regulatory, financial, and risk parameters for stakeholder decision making.

proficiency_levels.label: Institutionalises evaluation standards and assurance mechanisms to strengthen governance
proficiency_levels.description:
Establishes M/D/O-specific evaluation framework, defining the standards and quality thresholds (for e.g., scheduled frequency of evaluations, risk scoring norms, compliance benchmarks, etc) and embeds them into systems to ensure portfolio-wide assurance and consistency. Commissions independent assurance reviews, ensures timely action on findings, and reinforces the integrity, transparency, and credibility to strengthen governance.
Formulates and steers QAS as outlined by DMEO, to provide robust assurance on implementation quality and system performance.
Evaluates schemes and programmes against the criteria of REESI+E and other relevant frameworks suggested by M/D/O, DMEO, etc.
Embeds integrated risk management across evaluation processes, defines risk tolerance bands, and promotes risk-informed decision making.
Oversees fulfilment of mandated obligations related to governance, sustainability, crisis management, fund utilisation, and risk management across programmes, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and public interest.
Supervises harmonisation and convergence across programs/schemes, their rationalisation, effective fund management, to manage systemic risks and enhance long-term sustainability.
Chairs periodic reviews forums to monitor compliance and performance, recommend corrective actions, reallocate budgets, and support optimised utilisation of public funds.
Leads evaluation teams strategically by setting direction, clarifying standards, and guiding resolution of complex issues; mentors team members and institutionalises practices through SOPs, playbooks, and reviewer certification. Ensures programme dashboards capture schedule, cost, risk status, and decision logs, strengthening accessibility, auditability, and public trust in evaluation systems. I establish clear, contextualised evaluation frameworks for quality assurance while linking projects to outcomes, and compliance requirements.
I oversee integrated evaluation and recommend strategic decisions across programs to ensure transparency, accountability, and optimal use of public funds.
I strengthen systems, processes and people by using insights to address systemic bottlenecks, mitigating risks collaboratively.

theme_description: Ensures citizens’ welfare and satisfaction by improving the standards of accountable and transparent governance, implementing result-oriented administration through innovative interventions based on design thinking, and enhancing citizen-centric decision-making. Implements Open Government policies and practices, which include collaborating and forming partnerships with informed citizens, leveraging social capital, and promoting participative public service delivery by ensuring freedom and ease of access to information. Establish an efficient framework that ensures the timely and transparent delivery of services by various government departments through awareness of various social, political, economic and technological developments that may impact citizens.
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates the capability to receive, assess, process, track, escalate and resolve grievances raised by citizens or stakeholders, using structured mechanisms in accordance with the Centralised Public Grievance Redress And Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) and institutional frameworks. Ensures that every grievance is handled fairly, transparently and efficiently, thus strengthening accountability, enhancing service delivery and maintaining public trust.

proficiency_levels.label: Understands grievance processes and supports resolution
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands the objectives, timelines, escalation matrix, and disposal standards prescribed under CPGRAMS guidelines, departmental Citizen Charters, and DARPG advisories, Jan Sunwai, CM Helpline, and other departmental grievance cells.
Identifies types of grievances, such as citizen service delivery, employee service matters, beneficiary entitlements, infrastructure or procedural complaints, and policy feedback, and routes them appropriately.
Receives and logs grievances on CPGRAMS, State PG portals, CM Helpline platforms, or departmental grievance modules, ensuring accurate data entry, tagging, and classification.
Acknowledges grievances within prescribed timelines (for e.g., 48 hours/3 days as per departmental norms) and updates status regularly on the portal.
Identifies basic factual details, supporting documents, and jurisdiction before routing the grievance through e-Office workflow or prescribed forwarding matrix.
Drafts clear and reasoned replies citing relevant scheme guidelines, GFR provisions, service rules, or government orders, before closure.
Maintains complete digital and physical records, including action taken notes, file notings in e-Office, supporting documents, and communication logs.
Practises active listening, confidentiality, and neutrality during grievance hearings or public interactions, recording citizen submissions accurately and without bias. Escalates grievances beyond jurisdiction to the designated authority through prescribed escalation hierarchy in CPGRAMS or departmental SOP. I accurately record and process grievances within prescribed timelines using CPGRAMS and departmental systems.
I provide reasoned and rule-based responses while maintaining transparency and proper documentation.
I escalate and track grievances responsibly to support timely and accountable redressal.

proficiency_levels.label: Analyses and resolves grievances through structured processes
proficiency_levels.description:
Analyses grievances to identify underlying causes, responsible units, and applicable provisions under scheme guidelines, service rules, GFR, PFMS workflows, or programme SOPs.
Conducts structured fact-verification using document review, field verification reports, beneficiary records (for e.g., Poshan Tracker, MGNREGA MIS, PFMS transaction logs, etc) and prepares documented findings.
Uses digital grievance redressal platforms such as CPGRAMS, CM Helpline, RTPS portals, or State PG Cells to track pendency, resolution stages, and citizen communication.
Reviews grievance data and reports, to identify recurring issues (for e.g., delay in fund release under Mission Shakti, beneficiary verification under Poshan Tracker, issues in MGNREGA wage disbursal, etc), service delivery gaps, and procedural bottlenecks, recommending procedural or operational corrections.
Coordinates with departmental sections such as Establishment, Accounts, Programme Implementation, IT Cell, external agencies, etc to ensure end-to-end resolution and service recovery..
Applies defined performance parameters (for e.g., disposal timelines and recurrence patterns) to monitor effectiveness and recommend operational improvements in grievance redressal.
Facilitates structured grievance hearings ensuring accessibility for vulnerable groups (for e.g., PwDs, elderly, rural citizens, etc) and records proceedings formally.
Applies mediation techniques in cases involving multiple stakeholders, maintaining neutrality and fairness. Reviews closure quality to ensure responses are evidence-backed, compliant with Citizen Charter standards, and free from ambiguity. I resolve grievances through structured investigation, coordination, and rule-based decision making.
I analyse grievance data to correct systemic gaps and reduce recurrence.
I strengthen accountability by improving timeliness, documentation quality, and inter-unit coordination.

proficiency_levels.label: Strengthens institutional grievance systems to enhance accountability, transparency, and citizen trust
proficiency_levels.description:
Designs and periodically updates institutional SOPs for grievance receipt, classification, escalation, and closure aligned with DARPG, CPGRAMS reform guidelines, Sevottam framework, and Good Governance Index parameters.
Uses grievance analytics and recurrence patterns to inform policy modification, scheme redesign, and process simplification (for e.g., refining beneficiary verification in Poshan Abhiyaan or correcting fund-flow bottlenecks in PFMS-linked schemes such as Mission Shakti).
Establishes grievance performance metrics (for e.g., average disposal time, recurrence index, citizen satisfaction score, escalation compliance rate) and integrates them into departmental dashboards, supervisory reviews, and officer appraisal discussions to institutionalise accountability.
Standardises grievance handling competencies through structured training modules, case-based learning from resolved grievances, and periodic quality audits aligned with DARPG and Sevottam benchmarks.
Represents the Ministry/Department in PRAGATI reviews or DARPG consultations to advocate reforms that enhance fairness, transparency, and citizen-centric governance standards.
Oversees creation of institutional repositories of resolved cases to ensure consistency, knowledge sharing, and institutional memory.
Drives automation and digital integration (for e.g., AI-based categorisation tools, dashboard-based monitoring, etc) to enhance transparency and efficiency. Publishes periodic grievance performance dashboards (for e.g., pendency status, disposal rates, timelines met, etc) to enhance transparency and build citizen confidence. I institutionalise accountable grievance mechanisms that strengthen public trust.
I use grievance analytics, citizen feedback, and recurring trends to drive policy reforms, reduce systemic gaps, and enhance service delivery.
I embed accountability, digital integration, and public reporting mechanisms that build sustained citizen trust in grievance redressal processes.

theme_description: Demonstrates the ability to develop monitoring and evaluation framework for tracking implementation of central government policies, schemes, and projects for the Department, Ministry or Organisation. Identifies right set of data, information, and relevant parameters to evaluate. Undertakes qualitative and quantitative assessments to determine the progress of a government policy, schemes and project towards pre-specified goals and objectives, and to highlight any alarming gap that may hamper the slated outcomes & outputs. Facilitates in making informed decisions and adjustments to improve policy effectiveness, ensuring policies lead to desired outcomes and benefits. Identify successes, challenges, and lessons learned to enhance future policymaking and implementation processes for the Government of India.
sub_theme_description: Demonstrates the ability to collect and collate data based on defined M&E framework and conduct analysis to outline the performance of government programs in accordance with defined objectives and outcomes.

proficiency_levels.label: Collects and collates program data using prescribed M&E tools and procedures
proficiency_levels.description:
Understands the purpose and key components of key monitoring and evaluation frameworks, such as Theory of Change, Results-based Framework, etc, with associated methodologies for data collection and analysis, interpreting their importance for the effective functioning of government programs. Identifies stages of the M&E framework cycle in relation to the program, from setting objectives, selecting SMART indicators, planning data collection methods, to implementation and insights generation.
Demonstrates the ability to track indicators, utilise prescribed tools/technologies, and identify bottlenecks in relevant government programs of the M/D/O.
Assists in designing questionnaires and surveys, selecting representative samples, as per the defined M&E frameworks for a program.
Uses prescribed tools and methods (for e.g., questionnaires and surveys, scheme-specific IT-applications, such as POSHAN, CPGRAMS, etc) to collect, clean, and compile data.
Documents and reports progress on identified parameters in relevant formats, tools such as schemes’ MIS (for e.g., Poshan Tracker, PMAY MIS), Village/Block level registers & departmental formats, e-Office, etc, periodically.
Follows data-check procedures to ensure accuracy and consistency, and flags errors or inconsistencies or potential biases, as per the DMEO guidelines for data standards.
Summarises and shares key information to supervisors by interpreting compiled data, performing basic analysis, and drafting reports. Demonstrates sensitivity to local context and cultural differences while collecting and collating data under the defined M&E framework, ensuring ethical, inclusive, and citizen-centric approaches that strengthen the validity and reliability of programs, against stated objectives and outcomes. I understand the basics of monitoring and evaluation frameworks and their importance in government programs.
I collect, clean, and track data periodically using prescribed tools and methods.
I prepare clear summaries of key findings for supervisors based on compiled data.

proficiency_levels.label: Applies M&E frameworks to analyse performance, validate data, and support program improvements
proficiency_levels.description:
Develops structured data collection plans (for e.g., defining frequency, sampling strategy, tools, and verification protocols, etc) and applies survey design principles to create and operationalise M&E tools aligned with M/D/O guidelines and scheme objectives.
Integrates tools related to data collection, analytics, and visualisation, (for e.g., KoboToolbox, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, GIS, etc) to assist with survey design, conduct preliminary analysis, and present findings in a clear and concise manner.
Defines indicators, baselines, targets, and means of verification, and maps risks and assumptions relevant to program objectives to ensure alignment, optimise resources, enable smooth implementation and informed decision making.
Supervises the administration of quantitative and qualitative methods (for e.g., surveys, FGDs, KIIs, observational tools, etc) and ensures their ethical and standardised implementation.
Conducts data validation and triangulation using field reports, administrative data (for e.g., PFMS utilisation, scheme MIS, etc), and stakeholder inputs to enhance reliability.
Synthesises insights using appropriate analysis methods (for e.g., descriptive statistics, cross-tabulation, thematic coding, etc) using tools like SPSS, Stata, R, NVivo.
Prepares tailored insight briefs and visual dashboards for different stakeholder groups to inform mid-course corrections.
Manages M&E plans by coordinating with block/district-level teams, implementing agencies, and program units to ensure timely data flow. Analyses the competency gaps among the personnel on aspects of M&E in the team, and administers interventions such as training, mentoring, exposure visits, workshops, etc, to ensure capacity building in the M/D/O. I apply M&E frameworks and analysis methods to identify program gaps and recommend improvements.
I interpret and present insights clearly, enabling informed program decisions within the team.
I mentor and support officials to bridge their competency gaps in areas related to M&E.

proficiency_levels.label: Leads evidence-based program monitoring by integrating M&E across schemes and strengthening people, processes, and systems
proficiency_levels.description:
Sets the overall M&E strategy, aligning program logframes, indicators, and evaluation priorities with national guidelines and the M/D/O’s objectives. Oversees the development of results chains, Theory of Change models, indicator reference sheets, and data quality protocols to ensure clarity, consistency, and accountability across schemes in the M&E framework designs.
Reviews program performance against M&E plans, translating evidence into actionable recommendations for decision makers to drive design improvement, policy adjustments, and resource allocation.
Strengthens the M&E agenda of the M/D/O by defining data quality assurance frameworks and ensuring their follow-up across schemes’ MIS (for e.g., Poshan Tracker, PMAY MIS, etc), Village/Block-level registers & departmental formats, e-Office, etc.
Supervises compliance with protocols and guidelines concerning data collection procedures, data confidentiality, data management, program tracking, stakeholder interactions, ethical usage of AI-integrated tools, etc.
Ensures adherence to evaluation principles of relevance, efficiency, effectiveness, impact, and sustainability, and anchors all M&E approaches in citizen and service delivery outcomes.
Promotes adaptive monitoring and evaluation by combining systems diagnosis, mixed-methods data approach, theory-based assessments and iterative testing to monitor the beneficiary experience, generate insights and guide program improvements with stakeholders.
Builds institutional capacity in M&E by identifying the capacity gaps in personnel, technology and processes to build a cohesive environment that bridges the current and future gaps, enabling robust M&E cycles across programmes and schemes. Fosters collaborations and partnerships with line departments, field units, evaluators, research institutions, development partners, and other relevant stakeholders to refine approaches, deepen insights and broaden evidence use, ensuring informed program design and policy implementation. I shape and oversee the M/D/O’s M&E strategy to ensure programs generate measurable, citizen-focused impact.
I build M&E capacity by enhancing skills, systems, and technology with a forward-looking approach.
I collaborate with stakeholders to translate insights into decisions that enhance the design and effectiveness of government programs.
